name: Construction: plant, fleet & business
description: Machines, trucks, fleet management, NZ vehicle compliance, plant hire, contracts, project controls and the office words heard on NZ civil construction projects.

words.definition: The heavy machines and equipment a construction company uses, such as diggers, rollers, loaders and trucks.

examples.en: We've got over two hundred items of plant spread across the jobs.
examples.zh: 我们有两百多台机械分布在各个项目上。

examples.en: Plant costs are the biggest line in this cost report.
examples.zh: 机械费是这份成本报告里最大的一项。

words.note: 施工行业的 plant 不是“植物”或“工厂”，而是机械设备的统称，一般不可数：plant hire、plant yard、plant manager。

words.definition: Large powered machines such as excavators, bulldozers and cranes; in meetings people usually just say plant.

examples.en: Only ticketed operators can run the heavy machinery on this site.
examples.zh: 只有持证操作员才能开这个工地上的重型机械。

words.zh: 土方机械（挖、推、运、压土的机器）
words.definition: Machines that dig, push, carry and compact soil and rock, like diggers, dozers, loaders, dump trucks and rollers.

examples.en: Most of our earthmoving equipment is on the motorway job this month.
examples.zh: 这个月我们大部分土方机械都在高速公路项目上。

words.definition: The everyday New Zealand word for an excavator.

examples.en: The digger's broken down again, so the pipe crew can't start.
examples.zh: 挖掘机又坏了，所以管道班组没法开工。

examples.en: We need another digger on the Pukekohe job next week.
examples.zh: 下周 Pukekohe 的项目还需要一台挖掘机。

words.note: 新西兰工地和会议里几乎都说 digger，系统和资产登记里才常写 excavator。

words.definition: A machine with a boom, arm and bucket on a rotating body, used for digging trenches, loading trucks and moving material.

examples.en: Excavator utilisation dropped to sixty percent last month.
examples.zh: 上个月挖掘机利用率降到了百分之六十。

words.definition: A small excavator, often under about five tonnes, used in tight spaces such as footpaths and backyards.

examples.en: Put the mini digger on the trailer and take it to the footpath job.
examples.zh: 把小挖装上拖车，拉到人行道那个项目去。

words.note: mini digger 的吨位界限没有统一标准，各公司资产分类可能不同。

words.definition: Industry shorthand for a machine, usually a digger, with an operating weight of about 20 tonnes.

examples.en: Can we swap the 13-tonner for a 20-tonner on that job?
examples.zh: 那个项目能不能把13吨的换成20吨的？

words.note: 机器常按吨位叫：a 5-tonner, a 30-tonner。系统里通常用 size class 或 tonnage 字段记录。

words.zh: 工作重量（机器整备后的重量）
words.definition: The weight of a machine ready to work, with fuel, operator and standard attachments; used to class machines by size.

examples.en: Check the operating weight before you book the transporter.
examples.zh: 订运输车之前先查一下机器的工作重量。

words.definition: A heavy tracked machine with a large blade at the front for pushing soil and rock; usually just called a dozer.

examples.en: The dozer's been ripping rock all week on the bulk earthworks.
examples.zh: 推土机这一周都在大方量土方区松石头。

words.note: 口语几乎都说 dozer（DOH-zer）。

words.zh: 平地机（刮平路基、修整坡度的长车身机器）
words.definition: A long machine with a blade underneath, used to shape and level gravel, subgrade and roads to the exact height.

examples.en: The grader's trimming the subgrade before the basecourse goes down.
examples.zh: 铺基层之前，平地机正在修整路基。

words.note: grader 也叫 motor grader；这里不是“打分的人”。

words.definition: A machine with heavy drums or tyres that compacts soil, gravel or asphalt.

examples.en: We need two rollers on the asphalt crew tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚沥青班组需要两台压路机。

words.zh: 光轮压路机（钢轮表面光滑）
words.definition: A roller with a smooth steel drum, used to compact gravel, basecourse and asphalt.

examples.en: The smooth drum roller is booked for the seal on Thursday.
examples.zh: 光轮压路机已经约好周四用于封层。

words.zh: 凸块压路机（钢轮上有凸块，压实黏土）
words.definition: A roller whose drum is covered with raised pads, used to compact clay and silty soils.

examples.en: Clay fill needs the padfoot roller, not the smooth drum.
examples.zh: 黏土回填要用凸块压路机，不是光轮的。

words.note: 也叫 sheepsfoot roller（羊足碾），两种叫法在会议里都可能听到。

words.definition: A roller that runs on several rubber tyres instead of steel drums, often used on chip seal and asphalt.

examples.en: The rubber-tyred roller follows the chip spreader on the reseal.
examples.zh: 重新封层时，胶轮压路机跟在撒石车后面。

words.note: 也常叫 multi-tyred roller 或 pneumatic roller。

words.definition: A wheeled machine with a large front bucket for scooping and loading material into trucks or stockpiles.

examples.en: The loader's at the quarry loading out aggregate.
examples.zh: 装载机在采石场给车装骨料。

words.note: 也叫 front-end loader 或 wheel loader，三种叫法基本同义。

words.zh: 挖掘装载机（前装后挖，俗称“两头忙”）
words.definition: A tractor-type machine with a loader bucket at the front and a small digging arm at the back.

examples.en: A backhoe is handy for small drainage jobs because it can drive on the road.
examples.zh: 做小型排水活儿用挖掘装载机很方便，因为它能上路开。

words.note: 口语常简称 backhoe。

words.zh: 滑移装载机（小型、原地转向）
words.definition: A small, nimble loader that steers by turning the wheels on each side at different speeds; takes many attachments.

examples.en: Grab the skid steer with the sweeper attachment to clean up the site.
examples.zh: 开滑移装载机装上扫地附件，把工地清理一下。

words.note: 很多人把滑移装载机叫 Bobcat（品牌名泛化），就像把挖掘机叫 digger。

words.definition: A skid-steer-style loader on rubber tracks, better on soft or wet ground.

examples.en: On soft ground the compact track loader works when the wheeled one gets stuck.
examples.zh: 地面软的时候，履带式小装载机能干活，轮式的会陷住。

words.note: 常简称 CTL 或 track loader。

words.definition: A lifting machine with a telescopic boom that can carry forks or a bucket, used to lift materials to height.

examples.en: We'll need the telehandler to unload the pipes from the truck.
examples.zh: 我们需要伸缩臂叉装机把管子从卡车上卸下来。

words.note: 由 telescopic handler 缩写而来。

words.definition: A small vehicle with two forks at the front for lifting and moving pallets.

examples.en: The forklift in the yard is due for its service.
examples.zh: 堆场里的叉车该做保养了。

words.definition: A machine with a long boom and cables used to lift and move heavy loads.

examples.en: We'll need a crane on site for the bridge beams.
examples.zh: 吊装桥梁梁体时我们需要一台吊车进场。

words.definition: A crane mounted on a wheeled carrier that can drive between sites on the road.

examples.en: The mobile crane is booked for half a day to lift the culvert units.
examples.zh: 汽车吊订了半天，用来吊涵管构件。

words.definition: A crane on tracks, used for heavy lifts; it is taken to site in pieces on trucks and assembled there.

examples.en: The crawler crane takes two days to set up, so plan the lifts around that.
examples.zh: 履带吊要两天才能装好，所以吊装计划要考虑这一点。

words.definition: A machine that lays hot asphalt in an even layer across the road, fed by trucks tipping into its front hopper.

examples.en: The asphalt paver laid six hundred tonnes last night.
examples.zh: 沥青摊铺机昨晚摊铺了六百吨。

words.note: 新西兰常说 asphalt 或 hotmix；paver 单独出现也指这台机器。

words.definition: A machine that grinds off the top layer of an old road surface before new asphalt is laid.

examples.en: The profiler goes in first, then the paving crew follows the next night.
examples.zh: 铣刨机先进场，摊铺班组第二晚跟上。

words.note: 也叫 milling machine 或 cold planer；在新西兰道路工程里常说 profiler。

words.definition: A machine with a cutting chain or wheel that digs narrow trenches quickly, for example for cables.

examples.en: A trencher is quicker than a digger for long cable runs.
examples.zh: 长距离电缆沟用挖沟机比挖掘机快。

words.definition: Any machine that compacts soil, gravel, asphalt or rubbish by weight, vibration or impact.

examples.en: We hired an extra compactor to keep up with the fill.
examples.zh: 为了跟上填方进度，我们多租了一台压实机。

words.definition: A small walk-behind machine with a vibrating flat plate, used to compact gravel in trenches and small areas.

examples.en: The plate compactor came back from site with a cracked plate.
examples.zh: 那台平板夯从工地回来，底板裂了。

words.note: 属于 small plant（小型设备），一般用资产编号管理，不一定装 GPS。

words.definition: A small upright compactor that jumps up and down to compact soil in narrow trenches.

examples.en: Use the rammer around the manhole, the roller won't fit.
examples.zh: 检查井周围用冲击夯，压路机进不去。

words.zh: 铰接式自卸车（越野运土车）
words.definition: A large off-road dump truck that bends in the middle to steer, used to haul soil around big earthworks sites.

examples.en: We've got four articulated dump trucks hauling cut to fill.
examples.zh: 我们有四台铰接式自卸车在挖方区往填方区运土。

words.note: 常简称 ADT 或 artic dump；通常不能上公路，不同于 tipper（公路自卸车）。

words.definition: A small site vehicle with a tipping skip at the front, used to move material short distances.

examples.en: The dumper's handy for moving bedding sand along the trench.
examples.zh: 小翻斗车用来沿着沟槽运垫层砂很方便。

words.definition: A large machine that cuts a thin layer of soil, carries it in a bowl and spreads it elsewhere on big earthworks.

examples.en: The scrapers do the long hauls on the bulk earthworks.
examples.zh: 大方量土方的长距离运输由铲运机来做。

words.note: 和 profiler（铣刨机）不同；scraper 是土方机械。

words.zh: 洒水车（工地降尘、加水压实）
words.definition: A truck or trailer with a water tank and spray bar, used to keep dust down and add water to fill.

examples.en: Get the water cart out, the neighbours are complaining about the dust.
examples.zh: 把洒水车开出来，邻居在投诉灰尘了。

words.note: 新西兰工地常说 water cart；也有人说 water truck，指同一类车。

words.definition: A truck or attachment with brushes that sweeps dirt and loose chip off roads.

examples.en: Book the sweeper for after the profiling.
examples.zh: 铣刨完之后订一下扫路车。

words.definition: A diesel engine and alternator that provides electricity where there is no mains power.

examples.en: The site office runs off a generator until the power's connected.
examples.zh: 接通电之前，工地办公室靠发电机供电。

words.note: 口语也叫 genny 或 genset。

words.definition: A trailer-mounted mast with powerful lights and its own generator, used for night work.

examples.en: We need four lighting towers for the night shift on the motorway.
examples.zh: 高速公路夜班需要四座照明塔。

words.definition: Elevating work platform: a machine with a basket or platform that lifts people safely to work at height.

examples.en: Book an EWP to fix the lights on the workshop roof.
examples.zh: 订一台高空作业平台来修车间屋顶的灯。

words.note: 新西兰常用缩写 EWP；臂式的也叫 cherry picker。操作需要相应培训。

words.definition: An elevating work platform that rises straight up on folding criss-cross supports.

examples.en: The scissor lift is fine indoors but not on rough ground.
examples.zh: 剪叉式升降台在室内没问题，但不适合坑洼地面。

words.definition: A machine that drives or drills piles into the ground for foundations, bridges and retaining walls.

examples.en: The piling rig needs a level working platform before it can start.
examples.zh: 打桩机开工前需要一个平整的作业平台。

words.note: pile driver 指锤击打桩机；piling rig 是更泛的说法，也包括钻孔桩机。

words.definition: A machine that drills holes in rock or soil, for example for piles, anchors or ground investigation.

examples.en: The drill rig's on hire for the geotech investigation.
examples.zh: 钻机是租来做岩土勘察的。

words.zh: 小型设备（平板夯、发电机、切割机等）
words.definition: Small, portable equipment such as plate compactors, pumps, generators and saws, as opposed to big machines.

examples.en: Small plant keeps going missing because nobody signs it out.
examples.zh: 小型设备老是丢，因为没人登记借出。

words.note: 小型设备价值低、数量多，系统里常用资产标签或二维码追踪，而不是 GPS。

words.definition: A person trained and certified to drive and operate heavy machines such as diggers and rollers.

examples.en: We've got the machines, but we're short of plant operators.
examples.zh: 机器有，但是机械操作员不够。

words.note: 会议里常简称 operator；operator 也可能指运营方，注意上下文。

words.definition: A machine that moves on crawler tracks rather than wheels, giving better grip on soft ground.

examples.en: Tracked machines can't drive on the road, so they need a transporter.
examples.zh: 履带机械不能上路开，所以要用运输车拉。

words.note: 与 wheeled machine（轮式机械）相对。资产系统里常有一个字段区分 tracked / wheeled。

words.definition: A machine that runs on rubber tyres; it is faster to move and some can be driven on public roads.

examples.en: The wheeled excavator can drive itself between the two sites.
examples.zh: 轮式挖掘机可以自己开到另一个工地。

words.definition: A tool fitted to a machine, such as a bucket, breaker or auger, that can be swapped for different jobs.

examples.en: Attachments should have their own asset numbers so we know where they are.
examples.zh: 属具应该有自己的资产编号，这样我们才知道它们在哪。

words.note: 在资产系统里，attachment 常作为子资产挂在主机下，也可能单独计租。

words.definition: The open steel scoop on a digger or loader that digs and carries material.

examples.en: The digger's going out with a 600 mil bucket for the trench.
examples.zh: 那台挖掘机带600毫米宽的斗去挖沟。

words.note: NZ 口语里 mil = 毫米（millimetre），“600 mil bucket” 是指斗宽600毫米。

words.definition: A strong bucket with teeth on the front edge, used for general digging.

examples.en: Swap the digging bucket for the mud bucket once the trench is done.
examples.zh: 沟挖完后把挖斗换成泥斗。

words.definition: A wide bucket with a straight edge and no teeth, used for trimming slopes and finishing surfaces.

examples.en: He's using the batter bucket to tidy up the slopes.
examples.zh: 他在用修坡斗把边坡修整齐。

words.note: 也常叫 mud bucket 或 cleanup bucket。batter 在工程里指边坡。

words.definition: A bucket that can tilt sideways with hydraulics, so the operator can shape slopes and drains without moving the machine.

examples.en: A tilt bucket saves a lot of time on the swale work.
examples.zh: 做植草沟时用倾斜斗能省很多时间。

words.zh: 旋转倾斜器（可360度旋转并倾斜的连接器）
words.definition: A unit between the arm and the bucket that lets the attachment rotate fully and tilt, making the digger far more versatile.

examples.en: The new diggers all come with tiltrotators, so the operators love them.
examples.zh: 新挖掘机都配旋转倾斜器，所以操作员都很喜欢。

words.definition: A hydraulic hammer attachment for a digger that breaks rock and concrete.

examples.en: We hit rock at two metres, so we'll need the rock breaker.
examples.zh: 挖到两米碰到岩石了，需要上破碎锤。

words.note: 也叫 hydraulic hammer 或 breaker；口语直接说 the hammer。

words.definition: A large screw-shaped drill attachment for digging round holes, for example for posts or piles.

examples.en: Put the auger on the mini digger for the fence posts.
examples.zh: 给小挖装上螺旋钻打围栏桩孔。

words.zh: 松土器（推土机后面的大齿）
words.definition: A large claw-like tooth, usually on the back of a dozer, that tears up hard ground and rock.

examples.en: The dozer will have to rip that rock before the digger can load it.
examples.zh: 推土机得先把那块岩石松开，挖掘机才能装车。

words.note: 动词 rip 就是用松土器松土/破岩。

words.zh: 快换接头（快速更换属具）
words.definition: A coupler on the end of a digger's arm that lets the operator change buckets and attachments quickly.

examples.en: Every quick hitch has to be checked at the pre-start.
examples.zh: 每次班前检查都必须检查快换接头。

words.note: 也叫 quick coupler。快换接头是重要安全检查项（属具脱落事故）。

words.zh: 货叉（叉车或装载机上的）
words.definition: Two flat steel arms fitted to a forklift, loader or telehandler for lifting pallets and pipes.

examples.en: Put the forks on the loader to unload the pipe delivery.
examples.zh: 给装载机装上货叉，卸那批送来的管子。

words.note: 也说 pallet forks。

words.zh: 铲刀（推土机或平地机上的）
words.definition: The wide steel plate on a dozer or grader used to push and level material.

examples.en: The grader blade needs new cutting edges.
examples.zh: 平地机铲刀需要换新刀片。

words.definition: The main long arm of a digger or crane, attached to the machine body.

examples.en: There's a hydraulic leak on the boom cylinder.
examples.zh: 动臂油缸有液压漏油。

words.note: 挖掘机：boom（动臂）连着机身，arm/stick/dipper（斗杆）连着铲斗。

words.zh: 斗杆（挖掘机的第二节臂）
words.definition: The second section of a digger's arm, between the boom and the bucket; also called the stick or just the arm.

examples.en: A long dipper arm gives extra reach for deep trenches.
examples.zh: 长斗杆能让深沟挖得更远。

words.definition: The enclosed space where the operator sits to control the machine or truck.

examples.en: The aircon in the cab has packed up again.
examples.zh: 驾驶室的空调又坏了。

words.note: pack up 在新西兰口语里是“坏掉”的意思。

words.definition: Roll-over protective structure: the strong frame around a machine's cab that protects the operator if it rolls.

examples.en: You can't fit that cab extension, it voids the ROPS certification.
examples.zh: 那个驾驶室改装不能装，会让防翻滚认证失效。

words.note: 常与 FOPS（落物保护结构）一起出现。

words.definition: A heavy weight at the back of a digger or crane that balances the load being lifted.

examples.en: The counterweight comes off for transport, so it's two loads.
examples.zh: 运输时配重要拆下来，所以要分两车。

words.zh: 零尾回转（机尾不超出履带）
words.definition: A digger design where the back of the body stays within the tracks when it rotates, so it can work close to walls and traffic.

examples.en: We need a zero tail swing machine for working next to live traffic.
examples.zh: 紧挨着通行车辆作业，我们需要零尾回转的机器。

words.definition: The rotating movement of a digger's or crane's upper body; also the verb for turning it.

examples.en: Watch the counterweight when it slews.
examples.zh: 机器回转时注意配重。

words.note: slew 也写 slue；机器的回转轴承叫 slew ring。

words.definition: The large bearing that lets the upper body of a digger or crane rotate on its base.

examples.en: Replacing a slew ring is a big job, it'll be in the workshop for a week.
examples.zh: 换回转支承是大活儿，要在车间待一周。

words.definition: The system of pumps, oil, hoses and cylinders that powers a machine's movements.

examples.en: The hydraulics are slow when the oil's cold.
examples.zh: 油冷的时候液压动作慢。

words.definition: A strong flexible pipe carrying high-pressure hydraulic oil to the cylinders and attachments.

examples.en: A hydraulic hose burst and dumped oil on the road.
examples.zh: 一根液压软管爆了，油洒了一路。

words.note: hose burst（爆管）是最常见的故障之一，常需要现场维修和溢油报告。

words.definition: A cylinder and piston that pushes or pulls when hydraulic oil is pumped into it; it moves the boom, arm and bucket.

examples.en: The bucket ram is leaking, it needs new seals.
examples.zh: 铲斗油缸漏油，需要换密封件。

words.note: 正式叫 hydraulic cylinder；口语常说 ram。

words.definition: The continuous steel or rubber belts that some machines run on instead of wheels.

examples.en: The tracks are worn out, we'll budget for new ones next year.
examples.zh: 履带磨损严重，明年预算里要换新的。

words.definition: Tracks made of rubber, used on smaller machines so they don't damage roads and paved surfaces.

examples.en: Mini diggers on rubber tracks can work on the footpath without wrecking it.
examples.zh: 橡胶履带的小挖能在人行道上作业而不压坏路面。

words.zh: 底盘行走部分（履带、链轮、支重轮等）
words.definition: The lower part of a tracked machine: the tracks, rollers, idlers and sprockets.

examples.en: Undercarriage wear is one of the biggest costs on a dozer.
examples.zh: 底盘磨损是推土机最大的开支之一。

words.definition: The rubber tyres on trucks, loaders and other wheeled plant; a major running cost for the fleet.

examples.en: Tyres on the loader cost more than a new ute.
examples.zh: 装载机的轮胎比一辆新皮卡还贵。

words.note: 新西兰/英式拼写 tyre，美式 tire。

words.definition: The replaceable pointed steel teeth on the front edge of a bucket.

examples.en: Order a set of bucket teeth, they're nearly down to the adapters.
examples.zh: 订一套斗齿，快磨到齿座了。

words.definition: Parts that wear out with normal use and are replaced regularly, such as teeth, cutting edges, pins and bushes.

examples.en: Wear parts should be costed to the machine, not to the job.
examples.zh: 易损件的费用应该记在机器上，而不是项目上。

words.note: 也叫 GET（ground engaging tools，触土件）。

words.definition: The steel pins and sleeves at each joint of a digger's boom, arm and bucket, which wear and need replacing.

examples.en: There's a lot of slop in the bucket, the pins and bushes are worn.
examples.zh: 铲斗松旷得厉害，销轴和衬套磨损了。

words.definition: A small fitting on a joint where grease is pumped in with a grease gun.

examples.en: Grease every nipple on the boom at the daily check.
examples.zh: 每天检查时给动臂上的每个黄油嘴打黄油。

words.note: 也叫 grease fitting。机械每天要 greasing（打黄油），是班前检查的一部分。

words.definition: A hand tool for pumping grease into grease nipples on machine joints.

examples.en: There's a grease gun in every service truck.
examples.zh: 每辆维修车上都有一把黄油枪。

words.definition: Diesel particulate filter: a part in the exhaust that traps soot and must regularly burn it off, called a regen.

examples.en: The digger's in limp mode because the DPF needs a regen.
examples.zh: 挖掘机进了跛行模式，因为颗粒过滤器需要再生。

words.note: regen = regeneration（再生）；limp mode（跛行模式）是机器降功率保护。

words.definition: The flashing amber light on top of a machine or vehicle that warns people it is working.

examples.en: All site vehicles need a working beacon.
examples.zh: 所有工地车辆都必须有能用的警示灯。

words.definition: A camera at the back of a machine or truck that shows the operator what is behind.

examples.en: We're fitting reversing cameras to all the tippers.
examples.zh: 我们正在给所有自卸车装倒车摄像头。

words.definition: The beeper that sounds when a machine or truck reverses; some are a quieter broadband 'squawker' type.

examples.en: Night works need the quieter reversing alarms because of the neighbours.
examples.zh: 夜间施工因为邻居要用较安静的倒车报警器。

words.definition: A large motor vehicle for carrying goods or materials.

examples.en: We've got thirty trucks, mostly tippers.
examples.zh: 我们有三十辆卡车，大多是自卸车。

words.definition: A truck with a tray that lifts at the front to tip its load out the back.

examples.en: We need six tippers to cart the spoil away.
examples.zh: 我们需要六辆自卸车把弃土拉走。

words.note: 新西兰常说 tipper 或 tip truck；美式叫 dump truck。

words.zh: 卡车加挂车（带拖挂的自卸车）
words.definition: A rigid truck towing a separate trailer, both usually with tipping bodies; written T&T on schedules.

examples.en: A truck and trailer carries a lot more than a six-wheeler, so we need fewer loads.
examples.zh: 卡车加挂车比六轮车装得多得多，所以车次更少。

words.note: 在调度表和费率表上常写 T&T。按 load（车次）计数时要区分 T&T 和单车。

words.zh: 六轮卡车（三轴单车，常见自卸车）
words.definition: A rigid truck with three axles: one steering axle at the front and two axles at the back.

examples.en: Send a six-wheeler, a truck and trailer won't fit down that street.
examples.zh: 派一辆六轮车，带挂的开不进那条街。

words.note: six/eight 指“轮位”而不是轮胎个数（后轴通常是双胎）。俗称可能因人而异，系统里最好记录实际轴数和车型。

words.zh: 八轮卡车（四轴单车，重型自卸车）
words.definition: A large rigid truck with two front steering axles and two rear axles, common as a heavy tipper.

examples.en: The eight-wheeler can carry more than the six, but it's harder to get into tight sites.
examples.zh: 八轮车比六轮车装得多，但很难开进窄小的工地。

words.note: 通常是双转向前轴加双后轴；系统数据里以实际轴数为准。

words.definition: A tractor unit towing a semi-trailer that rests on its fifth wheel; short for semi-trailer truck.

examples.en: The steel beams are coming on a semi tomorrow.
examples.zh: 钢梁明天用半挂车运来。

words.definition: The front truck of a semi, with the engine and cab but no load space, which pulls a trailer.

examples.en: We've got three tractor units and five trailers.
examples.zh: 我们有三辆牵引车头和五个挂车。

words.note: 这里的 tractor 不是农用拖拉机；也叫 prime mover。

words.definition: An unpowered vehicle towed by a truck or ute.

examples.en: Each trailer needs its own rego and CoF.
examples.zh: 每个挂车都需要单独的注册和适用证书。

words.note: 在资产系统里挂车是独立资产，有自己的注册、检验和道路使用费。

words.zh: 低平板挂车（运重型机械）
words.definition: A trailer with a very low deck used to carry heavy machines like diggers and dozers on the road.

examples.en: The 30-tonner needs the low loader, not the tilt deck.
examples.zh: 30吨的要用低平板，不能用倾斜板车。

words.note: 也叫 transporter 或 low bed；美式叫 lowboy。

words.definition: A truck and trailer used to move machines between sites and the yard.

examples.en: The transporter's booked solid on Monday, can we move the digger on Tuesday?
examples.zh: 周一运输车排满了，挖掘机能周二再搬吗？

words.note: “Book the transporter” 就是安排拉机器；拉机器的费用叫 cartage 或 transport charges。

words.zh: 随车吊（卡车上带的折臂吊）
words.definition: A truck with its own folding crane for loading and unloading; from a brand name now used for any truck crane.

examples.en: Get a hiab to drop the manholes off at the site.
examples.zh: 叫一辆随车吊把检查井送到工地放下。

words.note: Hiab 本是品牌名（瑞典 Hiab），在新西兰被泛化，任何带折臂吊的卡车都叫 hiab；也可作动词：hiab it off。

words.definition: A truck with a flat open tray and no sides, for carrying pallets, pipes and equipment.

examples.en: The flat deck will bring the barriers out first thing.
examples.zh: 平板车一早会把护栏送过来。

words.note: 美式叫 flatbed。

words.zh: 倾斜板车（板面可倾斜方便机械开上去）
words.definition: A truck whose flat deck tilts and slides back so small machines and vehicles can drive straight on.

examples.en: The mini digger can go on the tilt deck.
examples.zh: 小挖可以用倾斜板车拉。

words.note: 也叫 tilt tray 或 tilt slide。

words.definition: The New Zealand word for a pickup truck: a light vehicle with a cab and an open tray at the back.

examples.en: Every foreman gets a ute and a fuel card.
examples.zh: 每个工长都配一辆皮卡和一张加油卡。

words.note: ute 来自 utility vehicle，新西兰/澳洲说法；美式叫 pickup。double cab 是双排座皮卡。

words.definition: A ute with two rows of seats and four doors, so a small crew can travel together.

examples.en: The crew needs a double cab, there are four of them.
examples.zh: 这个班组需要双排座的皮卡，他们有四个人。

words.zh: 维修服务车（流动维修车）
words.definition: A truck fitted with tools, oils, a compressor and often a small crane, used by mechanics to fix machines on site.

examples.en: The service truck's on its way to the job with the mechanic.
examples.zh: 维修车正载着技工赶往工地。

words.note: 也叫 field service truck；派车记录常是工单系统的一部分。

words.zh: 油罐车（给工地机械加油）
words.definition: A truck carrying diesel in a tank, used to refuel machines on site.

examples.en: The fuel tanker does a run round all the sites every morning.
examples.zh: 油罐车每天早上把所有工地跑一圈加油。

words.note: 也常叫 fuel truck；加油记录（哪台机器加了多少升）是燃油数据的重要来源。

words.definition: A truck with a powerful vacuum and tank that sucks up water, slurry or soil, for example to dig safely around services.

examples.en: We'll get a vacuum truck in to expose the gas line.
examples.zh: 我们叫一辆真空吸污车来把燃气管挖出来。

words.note: 口语也叫 vac truck 或 sucker truck；用于 hydro excavation（水力挖掘）。

words.definition: A vehicle with a gross vehicle mass of 3,500 kg or less, such as a car, van or ute.

examples.en: Light vehicles get a WoF; heavy vehicles need a CoF.
examples.zh: 轻型车辆做 WoF 检验，重型车辆要做 CoF。

words.note: 新西兰以 3,500 kg 总质量为界区分轻型和重型车辆，影响检验类型和驾照要求。

words.definition: A vehicle with a gross vehicle mass over 3,500 kg, such as most trucks.

examples.en: Heavy vehicles have their own RUC rates and CoF inspections.
examples.zh: 重型车辆有自己的道路使用费费率和 CoF 检验。

words.definition: Heavy motor vehicle: the formal term for a motor vehicle with a gross vehicle mass over 3,500 kg.

examples.en: Is the new crane truck an HMV for licensing?
examples.zh: 新的吊车在执照方面算重型机动车吗？

words.zh: 车辆总质量（最大允许满载重量）
words.definition: Gross vehicle mass: the maximum the vehicle may weigh when fully loaded, including itself, fuel, people and load.

examples.en: Check the GVM before you put the plate compactor and the water tank on that ute.
examples.zh: 往那辆皮卡上放平板夯和水箱之前，先查一下总质量。

words.definition: The weight of a truck or container when it is empty.

examples.en: The weighbridge subtracts the tare weight to get the load.
examples.zh: 地磅减去皮重就得到货重。

words.note: gross（毛重）− tare（皮重）= net（净重）。

words.definition: The weight of load a vehicle can legally carry, after its own weight is taken off.

examples.en: The new tippers have a bigger payload, so fewer loads per job.
examples.zh: 新自卸车载重更大，所以每个项目车次更少。

words.definition: The shaft that the wheels turn on; trucks are described and charged partly by their number of axles.

examples.en: RUC depends on the vehicle type and number of axles.
examples.zh: 道路使用费取决于车辆类型和轴数。

words.definition: The bar and ball fitted to the back of a ute or truck for towing a trailer.

examples.en: Make sure the ute has a towbar rated for the plant trailer.
examples.zh: 确认皮卡的拖车钩额定能力够拖机械挂车。

words.definition: A small trailer towed by a ute or truck, built to carry small machines like mini diggers and rollers.

examples.en: The plant trailer's brakes failed its CoF.
examples.zh: 机械挂车的刹车没通过 CoF 检验。

words.definition: A large scale set into the ground that weighs whole trucks, for example at a quarry.

examples.en: The weighbridge ticket shows twenty-two tonnes.
examples.zh: 地磅单上显示二十二吨。

words.note: 地磅单 (weighbridge ticket / docket) 常作为按吨计费的依据。

words.definition: A friendly informal New Zealand word for a truck driver.

examples.en: Ask the truckies to put the docket numbers in the app.
examples.zh: 让卡车司机把运单号录到应用里。

words.zh: 自有车司机（自己有卡车的承包司机）
words.definition: A truck driver who owns their own truck and is hired by a company as a subcontractor.

examples.en: On busy weeks we bring in owner-drivers to cover the cartage.
examples.zh: 忙的时候我们找自有车司机来补运力。

words.note: 与 company driver（公司雇员司机）相对；付款通常走分包结算，而不是工资。

words.definition: One full truckload of material; trucking work is often counted and charged per load.

examples.en: How many loads went to the tip yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天往垃圾场拉了多少车？

words.note: per load（按车次）vs per tonne（按吨）vs per hour（按小时）是三种常见的运费计价方式。

words.definition: Moving material or equipment by truck, or the charge for doing it.

examples.en: Is cartage included in the quarry's price?
examples.zh: 采石场的价格里包括运费吗？

words.note: 新西兰常说 cartage，而不是 haulage 或 shipping。cartage contractor = 运输承包商。

words.zh: 垃圾场；弃土场（新西兰口语）
words.definition: A New Zealand word for a rubbish dump or a place where trucks can dump spoil; also the verb for unloading a tipper.

examples.en: The nearest tip that takes contaminated soil is an hour away.
examples.zh: 最近能收污染土的弃土场在一小时车程外。

words.note: tip fees（倾倒费）按吨或按车收，是项目成本的一项。tip 也有“小费”和“建议”的意思，注意上下文。

words.zh: 鞍座（牵引车上连接半挂的转盘）
words.definition: The round coupling plate on a tractor unit that a semi-trailer locks onto.

examples.en: The fifth wheel needs greasing at every service.
examples.zh: 每次保养都要给鞍座打黄油。

words.definition: The bar at the front of a trailer that connects it to the truck towing it.

examples.en: A drawbar trailer is different from a semi-trailer.
examples.zh: 牵引杆挂车和半挂车不同。

words.zh: 引导车（护送超宽超大运输）
words.definition: A vehicle with warning signs and lights that travels with an overdimension load to warn other traffic.

examples.en: Moving the dozer at that width needs a pilot vehicle.
examples.zh: 那么宽的推土机运输要配引导车。

words.zh: 车队；机队（公司所有车辆和机械）
words.definition: All the vehicles and machines a company owns or runs, managed as one group.

examples.en: Our fleet is about four hundred assets, including the utes.
examples.zh: 我们的车队大约有四百台资产，包括皮卡。

words.note: 在施工公司，fleet 有时只指车辆（trucks, utes），有时也包括所有 plant，开会时最好确认范围。

words.zh: 资产（每台机器、车辆、属具）
words.definition: Any item the company owns and tracks, such as a machine, vehicle, attachment or trailer.

examples.en: Every asset needs a home depot and a cost centre in the new system.
examples.zh: 新系统里每个资产都要有所属车场和成本中心。

words.definition: The master list of every asset with its number, details, value and status.

examples.en: The asset register says we have twelve rollers, but the yard can only find ten.
examples.zh: 资产台账上说我们有十二台压路机，但堆场只找到十台。

words.note: 资产台账通常是 master data（主数据）的核心，也是财务折旧的依据。

words.definition: The company's own unique number for each machine or vehicle, painted on it and used on dockets and timesheets.

examples.en: Put the plant number on the timesheet, not just 'digger'.
examples.zh: 工时表上写机械编号，不要只写“挖掘机”。

words.note: 也叫 asset number 或 fleet number。现场人员常只用编号称呼机器，比如 “P512 is down”。

words.definition: The unique number the manufacturer gives a machine or part.

examples.en: We need the serial number to order the right parts.
examples.zh: 我们需要序列号才能订对零件。

words.definition: Vehicle identification number: the unique 17-character code that identifies a road vehicle.

examples.en: Rego records are matched to the VIN, not our fleet number.
examples.zh: 注册记录是按车辆识别码匹配的，而不是我们的车队编号。

words.definition: The manufacturer and the specific model of a machine or vehicle.

examples.en: Can the report break down fuel burn by make and model?
examples.zh: 报告能按品牌和型号细分油耗吗？

words.zh: 小时表（记录发动机运行小时）
words.definition: The meter on a machine that records how many hours the engine has run.

examples.en: Can you send me a photo of the hour meter?
examples.zh: 能把小时表拍个照片发给我吗？

words.note: 机械按小时而不是公里来安排保养和计费；也叫 hour clock。

words.definition: The total hours a machine's engine has run, read from the hour meter or telematics.

examples.en: It's got eight thousand engine hours, so it's due for replacement soon.
examples.zh: 它已经跑了八千小时，很快就该更换了。

words.note: 也说 machine hours 或 SMU（service meter units）。注意 engine hours 和 timesheet 上的 operator hours 可能对不上，这是常见的数据核对问题。

words.definition: The meter in a vehicle that shows the total distance it has travelled.

examples.en: Enter the odometer reading every time you fill up.
examples.zh: 每次加油都录入里程表读数。

words.zh: 轮毂里程表（重型车按它算道路使用费）
words.definition: A distance meter fitted to a wheel hub of a heavy vehicle or trailer, used to measure distance for road user charges.

examples.en: The trailer's hubodometer reading is needed for the RUC renewal.
examples.zh: 续买道路使用费需要挂车的轮毂里程表读数。

words.note: 口语常简称 hubo（HYOO-boh）。挂车没有发动机和仪表盘，所以靠它记里程。

words.definition: How often a machine or vehicle needs a service, measured in hours, kilometres or months.

examples.en: The service interval on the new diggers is five hundred hours.
examples.zh: 新挖掘机的保养间隔是五百小时。

words.definition: A planned service done when a machine reaches its service interval.

examples.en: Three machines are due for their scheduled service this week.
examples.zh: 这周有三台机器到期要做定期保养。

words.note: 常按小时数叫，比如 250-hour service、1000-hour service。

words.definition: Status showing that a machine has reached, or is about to reach, its next service.

examples.en: The dashboard shows anything with a service due in the next fifty hours.
examples.zh: 仪表板会显示未来五十小时内保养到期的设备。

words.note: overdue = 已过期未做。

words.definition: Planned maintenance done regularly to stop breakdowns before they happen.

examples.en: More preventive maintenance means fewer breakdowns on site.
examples.zh: 预防性维护做得多，工地上的故障就少。

words.note: 也写 preventative maintenance，简称 PM。与 reactive / breakdown maintenance（故障后维修）相对。

words.definition: When a machine or vehicle stops working and can't be used until it is repaired.

examples.en: We had three breakdowns on the motorway job last week.
examples.zh: 上周高速公路项目上有三次机械故障。

words.note: 动词短语 break down：The truck broke down on the motorway。

words.definition: The time a machine can't work because it is broken down or being serviced.

examples.en: Downtime on the pavers is costing us a fortune.
examples.zh: 摊铺机停机让我们损失惨重。

words.definition: The time a machine is working or ready to work, as opposed to being down.

examples.en: Fleet uptime was ninety-four percent last month.
examples.zh: 上个月机队的可用时间是百分之九十四。

words.definition: The percentage of time a machine is in working order and available to be used, whether or not it is actually used.

examples.en: Availability's fine, it's utilisation that's low.
examples.zh: 可用率没问题，是利用率低。

words.note: availability（能不能用）≠ utilisation（实际用了多少）。两者的分母定义要在报表里写清楚。

words.definition: The share of available time that a machine is actually working or on hire.

examples.en: If utilisation stays under fifty percent, we should sell it.
examples.zh: 如果利用率一直低于百分之五十，就该卖掉。

words.note: 新西兰拼写 utilisation，美式 utilization。计算口径（按小时表、按租赁天数还是按 GPS 运行时间）常引起争论。

words.zh: 怠速时间（发动机开着但不干活）
words.definition: Time when a machine's engine is running but it is not doing any work.

examples.en: Telematics shows forty percent idle time on that loader.
examples.zh: 车载数据显示那台装载机有百分之四十的怠速时间。

words.definition: The company's own garage where mechanics service and repair the fleet.

examples.en: It's in the workshop waiting on parts.
examples.zh: 它在车间里等零件。

words.definition: The company's depot where machines, trucks and materials are parked and stored when not on a job.

examples.en: Four rollers are sitting in the yard doing nothing.
examples.zh: 四台压路机停在堆场里闲着。

words.note: 也常说 depot。“back to the yard” = 退场回到车场。

words.zh: 柴油机械技工（重型机械维修工）
words.definition: A tradesperson who services and repairs diesel trucks and heavy machinery.

examples.en: We're two diesel mechanics short in the workshop.
examples.zh: 车间还缺两名柴油机械技工。

words.note: 新西兰也说 heavy diesel mechanic 或 heavy automotive technician。

words.zh: 装配钳工（机械维修技工）
words.definition: A tradesperson who repairs, fits and adjusts mechanical parts; in plant workshops often a fitter-welder.

examples.en: The fitter is rebuilding the bucket pins today.
examples.zh: 钳工今天在修铲斗销轴。

words.note: 和 mechanic 有重叠；fitter-welder 是既会钳工又会焊接的技工。

words.definition: When a mechanic is called out to a site to fix a broken machine, often with a callout charge.

examples.en: That was the third callout to the same digger this month.
examples.zh: 这是这个月第三次为同一台挖掘机出外勤维修。

words.note: after-hours callout = 下班后紧急出勤，通常费率更高。

words.definition: Spare parts used to repair and service machines.

examples.en: We're waiting on parts from Australia, so it'll be down till next week.
examples.zh: 我们在等澳洲寄来的零件，所以要停到下周。

words.note: “waiting on parts” 是停机原因中非常常见的一种。

words.definition: An order for parts that the supplier can't send yet because they are out of stock.

examples.en: The filters are on back order.
examples.zh: 滤芯缺货待发。

words.definition: The record for one workshop job: what was wrong, what was done, parts used and hours spent.

examples.en: Close off the job card so the costs go against the right machine.
examples.zh: 把工单关掉，这样费用才能记到对应机器上。

words.note: 也叫 work order。工单是维修成本和停机统计的来源数据。

words.definition: A formal request and record for maintenance or repair work on an asset.

examples.en: Raise a work order for the cracked windscreen.
examples.zh: 为那块裂了的挡风玻璃开个工单。

words.note: raise a work order = 开工单。

words.definition: A fault found on a machine or vehicle, for example at a pre-start check, that needs fixing.

examples.en: The operator reported a defect with the seatbelt.
examples.zh: 操作员报告了安全带的一个缺陷。

words.note: 在维修里 defect 指机器故障；在合同里 defect 指施工质量缺陷（见 defects liability period）。

words.definition: A code the machine's computer shows or sends when it detects a problem.

examples.en: Telematics sent a fault code for low coolant overnight.
examples.zh: 车载系统昨晚发来了冷却液不足的故障代码。

words.definition: A short check an operator or driver does before using a machine each day, often on a form or app.

examples.en: Pre-start checks are moving from paper books to the app.
examples.zh: 班前检查正在从纸本改到应用上。

words.note: 也叫 prestart、daily check 或 walkaround。检查不合格的机器通常要 tagged out（挂牌停用）。

words.definition: A machine with a danger or out-of-service tag on it, which must not be used until fixed and cleared.

examples.en: The roller's tagged out until the brakes are fixed.
examples.zh: 压路机挂了停用牌，刹车修好之前不能用。

words.note: 也说 out of service 或 red-tagged。

words.definition: A company card drivers use to buy fuel, which records litres, cost and vehicle for each fill.

examples.en: Fuel card data comes in weekly and gets matched to the vehicle.
examples.zh: 加油卡数据每周导入一次，并匹配到对应车辆。

words.definition: How much fuel a machine uses, usually measured in litres per hour.

examples.en: The older dozer's fuel burn is way higher than the new one.
examples.zh: 旧推土机的油耗比新的高很多。

words.note: 机械按升/小时（L/hr），车辆按升/百公里（L/100 km）。

words.definition: A fuel pump or tank used to fill vehicles and machines, for example at the yard.

examples.en: The yard bowser readings don't match the fuel issued.
examples.zh: 车场加油机的读数和发出的油量对不上。

words.note: 新西兰和澳洲口语，bow 发 “cow” 的音。

words.zh: 车用尿素（柴油尾气处理液）
words.definition: A liquid added to many modern diesel engines to cut exhaust pollution; the brand name is used for any diesel exhaust fluid.

examples.en: If it runs out of AdBlue, the machine goes into limp mode.
examples.zh: 尿素用完了，机器会进入跛行模式。

words.note: 通用名 DEF（diesel exhaust fluid），口语都说 AdBlue。

words.definition: Devices on machines and vehicles that send location, engine hours, fuel and fault data back to the office.

examples.en: The new diggers all have factory telematics, but the old ones need a box fitted.
examples.zh: 新挖掘机都有原厂车载系统，旧的需要另装设备。

words.note: 不同品牌的机器各有数据接口，汇总到一个系统是常见的集成难题。

words.definition: Using GPS units on vehicles and machines to see where they are and where they've been.

examples.en: GPS tracking showed the ute at the beach on Sunday.
examples.zh: GPS 追踪显示那辆皮卡周日在海边。

words.definition: A virtual boundary drawn on a map; the system alerts you when an asset enters or leaves it.

examples.en: We've put a geofence around each site so we know when plant arrives.
examples.zh: 我们在每个工地设了地理围栏，机器到场就知道。

words.definition: A machine or vehicle so damaged it is not worth fixing, or the removal of its value from the books.

examples.en: The ute was a write-off after the rollover.
examples.zh: 那辆皮卡翻车后报废了。

words.note: 动词短语 write off：The insurer wrote it off。

words.definition: The fall in an asset's value over time, recorded as a cost in the accounts.

examples.en: Depreciation is built into the internal hire rate.
examples.zh: 折旧已经算进内部租赁费率里了。

words.definition: Getting rid of an asset by selling it, auctioning it or scrapping it.

examples.en: We'll put the old trucks up for disposal after the new ones arrive.
examples.zh: 新卡车到了以后，旧的就拿去处置。

words.definition: How long the company keeps a type of machine or vehicle before replacing it, in years or hours.

examples.en: Utes are on a four-year replacement cycle.
examples.zh: 皮卡按四年周期更换。

words.definition: How long an asset is expected to be useful, used to plan replacement and calculate depreciation.

examples.en: We've extended the useful life of the rollers to ten years.
examples.zh: 我们把压路机的使用年限延长到了十年。

words.definition: The total cost of owning a machine from purchase to disposal, including fuel, repairs and depreciation.

examples.en: The cheaper digger has a higher whole-of-life cost.
examples.zh: 便宜的那台挖掘机全生命周期成本更高。

words.note: 也说 total cost of ownership (TCO)。

words.definition: What a machine really costs to own and run for each working hour.

examples.en: Our cost per hour for the 20-tonner is higher than the hire rate.
examples.zh: 我们20吨挖掘机的每小时成本比外租价还高。

words.definition: Taking samples of engine or hydraulic oil and testing them in a lab to spot wear before a failure.

examples.en: Oil sampling picked up metal in the final drive.
examples.zh: 油样分析发现终传动里有金属屑。

words.zh: 公用车辆（不固定分配给个人）
words.definition: A vehicle shared by staff and booked when needed, rather than assigned to one person.

examples.en: Book a pool vehicle if you're heading out to site.
examples.zh: 要去工地的话就订一辆公用车。

words.definition: Which person, crew or job a vehicle or machine is assigned to.

examples.en: The allocation board's out of date, half these machines have moved.
examples.zh: 分配看板过时了，一半的机器都换地方了。

words.definition: An area with drainage where machines and trucks are washed before servicing or leaving a site.

examples.en: Machines must go through the wash bay before going into the workshop.
examples.zh: 机器进车间前必须先过洗车台。

words.zh: 车辆安全检验证（轻型车）
words.definition: Warrant of fitness: the regular safety inspection certificate for light vehicles such as cars and utes.

examples.en: Three utes have WoFs expiring this month.
examples.zh: 有三辆皮卡的 WoF 这个月到期。

words.note: 读作 “woff”。仅适用于轻型车辆；重型车辆用 CoF。

words.zh: 车辆适用证书（重型车检验）
words.definition: Certificate of fitness: the regular, stricter safety inspection certificate for heavy vehicles and some commercial vehicles.

examples.en: The tipper failed its CoF on the brakes.
examples.zh: 那辆自卸车的 CoF 刹车项没过。

words.note: 重型车（总质量超过 3,500 kg）和一些营运车辆需要 CoF 而不是 WoF。

words.definition: Short for registration: the vehicle licence you pay to keep a vehicle legally on the road.

examples.en: Rego for the whole fleet is about to come up for renewal.
examples.zh: 整个车队的注册马上要续费了。

words.note: 新西兰口语。rego 也常指车牌号：What's the rego?

words.definition: The plate on the front and back of a vehicle showing its registration number.

examples.en: Search by number plate, not by fleet number.
examples.zh: 按车牌搜，不要按车队编号。

words.note: 美式叫 licence/license plate。新西兰车牌号也常直接叫 rego。

words.definition: Road user charges: distance-based charges for using NZ roads, paid by owners of diesel vehicles, heavy vehicles and electric vehicles.

examples.en: RUC is a big part of the running cost for the trucks.
examples.zh: 道路使用费是卡车运行成本的一大块。

words.note: 读作 “ruck”。汽油轻型车的道路费含在油价里；柴油车、重型车等要单独按公里购买 RUC。

words.zh: 道路使用费许可（按里程预购）
words.definition: The licence showing the distance a vehicle has prepaid RUC for, bought in units of 1,000 km.

examples.en: The RUC licence on the T&T runs out at the next ten thousand kilometres.
examples.zh: 那辆带挂车的道路使用费许可再跑一万公里就到期了。

words.note: 正式名称 distance licence；如果里程超出已购范围就是违规。很多公司用 eRUC（电子 RUC）自动购买。

words.definition: Electronic road user charges: RUC bought and tracked automatically through an approved electronic device and provider.

examples.en: With eRUC we don't have to chase the drivers for hubo readings.
examples.zh: 用了电子 RUC，就不用追着司机要轮毂里程表读数了。

words.definition: The NZ Transport Agency, the government agency for land transport, vehicle licensing and state highways; also called Waka Kotahi.

examples.en: The RUC rates are set by the government and collected through NZTA.
examples.zh: 道路使用费费率由政府设定，通过交通局收取。

words.note: 全称 NZ Transport Agency Waka Kotahi。也负责国道（state highways），因此常常也是施工项目的业主。

words.zh: 新西兰交通局（毛利语名称）
words.definition: The Māori name of the NZ Transport Agency, often used on its own in conversation.

examples.en: Waka Kotahi is the client on that state highway job.
examples.zh: 那个国道项目的业主是交通局。

words.definition: The licence that allows someone to drive; in NZ the class shows which size of vehicle they can drive.

examples.en: We need to record every driver's licence class and expiry date.
examples.zh: 我们要记录每个司机的驾照类别和到期日。

words.note: 新西兰官方写 driver licence（不是 driver's license）。

words.definition: An extra qualification added to a driver licence that allows a special kind of driving, such as W, T, R or F.

examples.en: Check his endorsements before you put him on the roller.
examples.zh: 安排他开压路机之前先查一下他的驾照附加资质。

words.definition: The class on an NZ driver licence that shows the size of vehicle you may drive, from Class 1 (cars) to Class 5 (heavy combinations).

examples.en: Record each driver's licence class so we don't put a Class 1 driver in a tipper.
examples.zh: 记录每个司机的驾照类别，免得让只有1类驾照的人开自卸车。

words.note: Class 1 = 小车/轻型车；Class 2 = 中型单体车；Class 3 = 中型组合车；Class 4 = 重型单体车；Class 5 = 重型组合车（如带挂车、半挂）。具体重量界限以 NZTA 为准。

words.zh: W/T/R 驾照附加资质（轮式/履带/压路机上路）
words.definition: The driver licence endorsements for driving special wheeled vehicles (W), tracked vehicles (T) and rollers (R) on a road.

examples.en: All our operators are expected to get their WTR endorsements.
examples.zh: 我们要求所有操作员都考 W/T/R 附加资质。

words.note: W = wheels（轮式特种车，如装载机、平地机），T = tracks（履带车），R = rollers（压路机）。F = forklift（叉车）。这些是在道路上驾驶这些机械所需的。

words.zh: F 附加资质（叉车上路）
words.definition: The driver licence endorsement needed to drive a forklift on a road.

examples.en: The yard guys only need a forklift certificate, but the F endorsement is for the road.
examples.zh: 堆场的人只需要叉车证，F 附加资质是上路用的。

words.zh: D 附加资质（危险品运输）
words.definition: The driver licence endorsement for carrying dangerous goods, such as fuel, above certain quantities.

examples.en: The fuel tanker driver needs a D endorsement.
examples.zh: 油罐车司机需要 D 附加资质。

words.definition: A record truck drivers keep of their work and rest times, to comply with NZ work time rules.

examples.en: Most of our drivers have moved to electronic logbooks.
examples.zh: 我们大部分司机都改用电子工作日志了。

words.note: 与疲劳管理（fatigue management）有关；有电子版 e-logbook。也可指车辆维修记录本，注意上下文。

words.definition: Rules and practices that stop drivers and operators working so long that tiredness makes them unsafe.

examples.en: Night shifts mean we have to watch fatigue management closely.
examples.zh: 上夜班意味着我们要密切关注疲劳管理。

words.definition: In NZ transport rules, the time a driver spends working, which is limited and must be followed by rest breaks.

examples.en: Loading time counts as work time, not just driving.
examples.zh: 装货时间也算工作时间，不只是开车。

words.definition: A permit that allows a vehicle to carry more weight than the normal legal limit on certain roads.

examples.en: Moving the big dozer with its blade on needs an overweight permit.
examples.zh: 带着铲刀运那台大推土机需要超重许可。

words.definition: A load or vehicle that is wider, longer or higher than the normal legal limits and needs special rules or permits.

examples.en: It's an overdimension load, so it can only move at certain times.
examples.zh: 这是超尺寸运输，只能在特定时间段移动。

words.note: 常缩写 over-dimension 或 OD；可能需要 pilot vehicle（引导车）。

words.definition: Transport service licence: a licence from NZTA that businesses need to run certain transport services, such as carrying goods with heavy vehicles.

examples.en: Our TSL number has to be shown on the trucks.
examples.zh: 我们的运输服务许可证号必须标在卡车上。

words.definition: Fringe benefit tax: a NZ tax an employer pays when staff can use a work vehicle privately.

examples.en: If the ute goes home at weekends, there could be FBT on it.
examples.zh: 如果皮卡周末开回家，可能要交附加福利税。

words.note: 由税务局 IRD 管理；具体是否需要交以 IRD 规则和会计意见为准。

words.zh: 车辆安全检验证（WoF 全称）
words.definition: The full name of the WoF, the regular safety check for light vehicles in New Zealand.

examples.en: Book the ute in for its Warrant of Fitness.
examples.zh: 给皮卡约个 WoF 检验。

words.note: 会议里几乎都说 WoF；也用比喻：“the system needs a warrant of fitness” 意思是“系统需要做一次体检”。

words.definition: Renting machines and equipment, either from a hire company or from your own company's fleet.

examples.en: Plant hire is our second biggest cost after labour.
examples.zh: 机械租赁是仅次于人工的第二大成本。

words.definition: A business that rents out machines and equipment to contractors.

examples.en: If our own rollers are all out, we'll get one from a hire company.
examples.zh: 如果我们自己的压路机都派出去了，就从租赁公司租一台。

words.zh: 干租（只租机器，不带操作员）
words.definition: Hiring a machine without an operator; the hirer supplies the operator and usually the fuel.

examples.en: We dry hire the excavator and use our own operator.
examples.zh: 我们干租挖掘机，用自己的操作员。

words.note: 与 wet hire 相对。合同里要写清燃油、保险、损坏责任归谁。

words.zh: 湿租（机器连同操作员一起租）
words.definition: Hiring a machine together with an operator, and often fuel, for one combined rate.

examples.en: The crane is on wet hire, operator and fuel included.
examples.zh: 吊车是湿租的，含操作员和燃油。

words.note: 也叫 operated hire。wet 不是“湿”，而是“带人（有时带油）”。是否含油各公司不同，要看费率表。

words.definition: To rent a machine from another company because your own fleet can't cover the need.

examples.en: We had to hire in two rollers for the paving season.
examples.zh: 铺路旺季我们只好从外面租了两台压路机。

words.note: hired-in plant（外租设备）vs own plant（自有设备），在成本报表中常分开统计。

words.zh: 内部租赁（自有设备向项目收费）
words.definition: Charging a job for using the company's own machines at set internal rates, so plant costs land on the right job.

examples.en: Internal hire is charged from the plant timesheets each week.
examples.zh: 内部租赁费每周根据机械工时表计入项目。

words.note: 也叫 internal charge-out 或 plant recovery。设备部门像一个内部租赁公司，向各项目“收租”。

words.definition: The rate per hour or day that is charged for a machine, vehicle or person.

examples.en: What's the charge-out rate for a 13-tonne digger with operator?
examples.zh: 13吨挖掘机带操作员的收费费率是多少？

words.definition: The price for hiring a machine for a set time, such as per hour, day or week.

examples.en: The hire rates haven't been updated since last year.
examples.zh: 租赁费率从去年以来就没更新过。

words.definition: A price charged for each hour a machine or person works.

examples.en: Most of the diggers are charged at an hourly rate.
examples.zh: 大部分挖掘机都按小时收费。

words.definition: A fixed price for one day's use of a machine, vehicle or person.

examples.en: The lighting towers are on a day rate.
examples.zh: 照明塔按天收费。

words.definition: A price for one week's hire, usually cheaper per day than the day rate.

examples.en: If we need it for more than three days, the weekly rate is cheaper.
examples.zh: 如果要用三天以上，按周租更便宜。

words.definition: A reduced rate charged when a machine is on site and available but not working, for example during bad weather.

examples.en: The crane was on standby rate for two days because of the wind.
examples.zh: 因为大风，吊车按待命费率算了两天。

words.note: standby 期间是否收费、收多少，常是变更和索赔的争议点。

words.definition: The smallest amount a hire company will charge, such as a minimum number of hours per booking.

examples.en: There's a four-hour minimum charge on the crane.
examples.zh: 吊车最低按四小时收费。

words.note: 也说 minimum hire。

words.definition: The point when a hired machine is returned or released and charges stop.

examples.en: Call the hire company and put the compactor off hire today.
examples.zh: 给租赁公司打电话，今天就把平板夯退租。

words.note: on hire = 正在计租。忘记 off-hire 闲置的设备是常见的浪费。

words.definition: Currently hired out and being charged for.

examples.en: We've got six lighting towers on hire that nobody's using.
examples.zh: 我们有六座照明塔在计租，但没人用。

words.definition: The paper or digital record of a hire, showing the machine, dates, hours and rate.

examples.en: Match every hire invoice against the hire dockets.
examples.zh: 每张租赁发票都要和租赁单据核对。

words.definition: The cost of carting a machine to and from the site, charged on top of the hire.

examples.en: The hire rate's good, but the transport charges kill it.
examples.zh: 租金还行，但运输费太贵了。

words.definition: Short for mobilisation and demobilisation: moving people, plant and site facilities onto a job and off it at the end.

examples.en: We'll price mob and demob as separate items.
examples.zh: 进场和退场我们会单独报价。

words.note: mob = mobilisation，demob = demobilisation。新西兰合同里也常叫 establishment / disestablishment。

words.definition: Setting up a site at the start of a job: bringing in plant, site offices, fencing and services; also the price item for it.

examples.en: Establishment is in the P&G, not in the rates.
examples.zh: 进场费用算在 P&G 里，不在单价里。

words.note: disestablishment = 退场、清场。

words.zh: 自有机械操作员（自带机器的分包商）
words.definition: A person who owns a machine or truck and is hired with it to work for a contractor.

examples.en: We've got three owner-operators on the job this week.
examples.zh: 这周项目上有三个自带机器的操作员。

words.note: 与 owner-driver 类似；结算一般走分包付款，不进工资系统。

words.definition: The list of standard rates for each type of machine, vehicle and labour.

examples.en: The new rate card starts on the first of July.
examples.zh: 新费率表从七月一日起执行。

words.definition: How much of the fleet's real cost is charged back to jobs through internal hire.

examples.en: We under-recovered on the rollers last year because they sat in the yard.
examples.zh: 去年压路机费用回收不足，因为它们一直停在堆场。

words.note: under-recovery（回收不足）意味着设备成本没有被项目覆盖。

words.definition: A charge for a machine kept on a job but not being used.

examples.en: If the digger's parked up for a week, the job still pays an idle charge.
examples.zh: 挖掘机停一周不用，项目还是要付闲置费。

words.definition: An extra fee paid to a hire company to limit what you pay if the hired machine is damaged.

examples.en: Do we take the damage waiver or cover it under our own insurance?
examples.zh: 我们是买损坏免责，还是用我们自己的保险？

words.definition: The contract with a hire company setting out the rates, terms and who is responsible for what.

examples.en: Check the hire agreement for who pays for tyre damage.
examples.zh: 查一下租赁协议，轮胎损坏由谁付钱。

words.definition: A formal offer to do a job for a stated price, or the process of inviting such offers.

examples.en: We're pricing three tenders this month.
examples.zh: 我们这个月在做三个投标报价。

examples.en: The tender closes at 4 pm on Friday.
examples.zh: 投标周五下午四点截止。

words.note: 名词和动词都用：tender for a job（投标）。新西兰政府项目常在 GETS 网站上发布招标。

words.zh: 新西兰政府电子招标平台
words.definition: Government Electronic Tenders Service: the NZ website where government agencies publish tenders.

examples.en: Keep an eye on GETS for the new council roading contracts.
examples.zh: 留意 GETS 上新的市政道路合同。

words.definition: Request for tender: a formal document inviting contractors to submit priced tenders.

examples.en: The RFT came out today with a six-week tender period.
examples.zh: 招标书今天发出，投标期六周。

words.definition: Request for proposal: an invitation to propose how you would do a job and at what price, often for less defined work.

examples.en: The council's RFP asks for methodology and team as well as price.
examples.zh: 市政的征求建议书除了价格还要求方法和团队。

words.definition: Request for quotation: asking a supplier or subcontractor for a price for defined goods or work.

examples.en: Send an RFQ to three quarries for the aggregate.
examples.zh: 给三家采石场发骨料询价。

words.definition: Expression of interest: a first-stage response showing you want to tender and are capable, before the full tender.

examples.en: We got through the EOI, so now we're shortlisted for the tender.
examples.zh: 我们通过了意向书阶段，现在进入投标短名单了。

words.note: 也叫 ROI（registration of interest）。

words.definition: An offer to do work for a price; in practice often used to mean the same as tender.

examples.en: Our bid came in second on price.
examples.zh: 我们的报价排第二。

words.definition: A calculated forecast of what a job will cost, used to set the tender price.

examples.en: The estimate assumed two weeks of dewatering.
examples.zh: 估价里假设了两周的降水。

words.note: 名词读 ES-tih-mut，动词读 ES-tih-mate。

words.definition: The person who works out the costs and prices for a tender.

examples.en: The estimator needs our latest plant rates for the tender.
examples.zh: 估价师投标需要我们最新的机械费率。

words.zh: 工程量计算（从图纸算量）
words.definition: Measuring quantities, such as metres of pipe or cubic metres of fill, from drawings to price a job.

examples.en: I'm halfway through the take-off for the stormwater.
examples.zh: 雨水管的工程量我算了一半。

words.note: 也叫 quantity take-off。动词短语 take off quantities。

words.definition: The list of work items, quantities and rates in a contract, used to price the tender and to value payments.

examples.en: Each line in the schedule of prices maps to a cost code.
examples.zh: 价格表里每一行都对应一个成本编码。

words.note: 新西兰合同常用 schedule of prices 或 schedule of quantities；英国常叫 BoQ。

words.definition: Bill of quantities: a list of all work items with measured quantities, priced by tenderers.

examples.en: The BoQ quantities look light on the excavation.
examples.zh: 工程量清单上的开挖量看起来偏少。

words.definition: A single fixed price for a defined piece of work, not paid by measured quantities.

examples.en: It's a lump sum contract, so we carry the quantity risk.
examples.zh: 这是总价合同，所以工程量风险由我们承担。

words.definition: A contract type where the work done is measured and paid at the agreed rates, so the final price depends on actual quantities.

examples.en: Under measure and value, we get paid for the extra rock we dig.
examples.zh: 按实计量的话，多挖的岩石我们能拿到钱。

words.note: 也写 measure-and-value；与 lump sum（总价）相对。

words.definition: The prices per unit of work in the schedule, such as dollars per metre or per cubic metre.

examples.en: Our rates for trenching are too low for this ground.
examples.zh: 以这里的地质条件，我们的挖沟单价太低了。

words.zh: 单位单价（每单位工作量价格）
words.definition: The price for one unit of an item, for example dollars per metre of pipe.

examples.en: The unit rate for 300 mil pipe includes bedding and backfill.
examples.zh: 300毫米管的单价包含垫层和回填。

words.definition: An allowance in the contract for work that can't be priced accurately yet; it is adjusted to the real cost later.

examples.en: The service relocations are covered by a provisional sum.
examples.zh: 管线迁改由暂定金额覆盖。

words.note: 常缩写 PS。与 contingency（不可预见费）不同：PS 写在合同里，由业主决定是否动用。

words.zh: 主要成本金额（指定材料/分包的暂估价）
words.definition: Prime cost sum: an allowance in the contract for goods or work to be supplied by a nominated supplier or subcontractor.

examples.en: The lighting supply is a PC sum in the schedule.
examples.zh: 照明设备供货在价格表里是 PC sum。

words.definition: Money set aside to cover risks and unexpected costs.

examples.en: We've used half the contingency and we're only a third of the way through.
examples.zh: 工程才做了三分之一，不可预见费已经用掉一半了。

words.definition: The difference between the price and the cost, often shown as a percentage.

examples.en: We priced it at eight percent margin.
examples.zh: 我们按百分之八的利润率报价。

words.note: margin fade（利润流失）= 项目进行中利润率比投标时降低。

words.definition: Company costs not tied to a single job, such as office rent and head office staff.

examples.en: Overheads are recovered as a percentage on every job.
examples.zh: 管理费按比例分摊到每个项目回收。

words.zh: 措施费/现场管理费（Preliminary and General）
words.definition: Preliminary and general: the job's site overhead costs, such as supervision, site offices, insurance and traffic management, priced separately.

examples.en: Extra time on the job means extra P&G.
examples.zh: 工期延长意味着现场管理费增加。

words.note: 新西兰常用说法，读作 “P and G”。工期延长索赔常按每周 P&G 计算。

words.definition: A change to the work in the contract, such as extra, less or different work, usually with a change in price or time.

examples.en: The client wants the footpath widened, so that's a variation.
examples.zh: 业主要加宽人行道，所以这是变更。

words.note: 新西兰/英国常说 variation；美国叫 change order。

words.definition: The formal written instruction that confirms a variation to the contract.

examples.en: Don't start the extra work until we've got a variation order.
examples.zh: 拿到变更指令之前不要开始额外工作。

words.note: 常缩写 VO。

words.definition: A request for more money or time under the contract, or a request for payment for work done.

examples.en: We'll put in a claim for the wet weather delays.
examples.zh: 我们会就雨天延误提出索赔。

words.definition: A formal claim for payment for work done in a period, usually monthly; under NZ law it has a defined meaning.

examples.en: The payment claim goes to the engineer on the twentieth.
examples.zh: 付款申请二十号交给工程师。

words.note: 新西兰《Construction Contracts Act 2002》对 payment claim 和 payment schedule 有程序要求。

words.definition: A claim for payment based on how much of the work has been done so far.

examples.en: This month's progress claim is down because of the rain.
examples.zh: 因为下雨，这个月的进度款申请少了。

words.note: 与 payment claim 在日常对话中基本同义。

words.zh: 付款回复表（对付款申请的正式回复）
words.definition: The payer's formal reply to a payment claim, stating how much they will pay and why any amount is different.

examples.en: If they don't send a payment schedule in time, they can be liable for the full claim.
examples.zh: 如果他们没按时回复付款表，可能就得支付申请的全额。

words.note: 这里的 schedule 不是“进度计划”，是“清单/表”。

words.definition: The NZ law that sets rules for payments, payment claims, retentions and adjudication in construction contracts.

examples.en: The payment claim has to say it's made under the Construction Contracts Act.
examples.zh: 付款申请必须注明是依据《建筑合同法》提出的。

words.note: 常简称 the CCA 或 the Act。

words.zh: 裁决（快速解决合同争议）
words.definition: A fast way to settle construction payment disputes using an independent adjudicator, available under the Construction Contracts Act.

examples.en: If they won't pay, we can take it to adjudication.
examples.zh: 如果他们不付钱，我们可以申请裁决。

words.definition: Part of each payment held back by the client until the work is finished and defects are fixed.

examples.en: We've got a lot of money tied up in retentions.
examples.zh: 我们有很多钱压在保留金里。

words.note: 新西兰法律规定保留金要以信托方式保管（held on trust）。保留金一般在实际完工和缺陷期结束时分两次释放。

words.definition: The stage when the works are finished enough to be used for their purpose, even if minor defects remain.

examples.en: Practical completion is planned for the end of March.
examples.zh: 实际完工计划在三月底。

words.note: 常缩写 PC；同一缩写也可能指 PC sum，注意上下文。

words.definition: The period after completion when the contractor must come back and fix defects at its own cost.

examples.en: We're still in the defects liability period on that subdivision.
examples.zh: 那个住宅开发项目还在缺陷责任期内。

words.note: NZS 3910 合同里叫 defects notification period，意思相同；常缩写 DLP 或 DNP。

words.definition: The NZS 3910 term for the period after practical completion during which defects must be notified and fixed.

examples.en: The defects notification period runs for twelve months.
examples.zh: 缺陷通知期为十二个月。

words.definition: A fixed amount per day or week the contractor must pay the client if the work finishes late.

examples.en: Liquidated damages are five thousand dollars a day, so we can't afford to be late.
examples.zh: 误期赔偿每天五千元，所以我们不能延误。

words.note: 常缩写 LDs。

words.definition: Extra time to finish the work granted under the contract, for example for client changes or bad weather.

examples.en: We'll apply for an extension of time for the wet days.
examples.zh: 我们会为雨天申请工期延长。

words.note: 常缩写 EOT。

words.zh: 新西兰标准土木/建筑施工合同条件
words.definition: The New Zealand standard conditions of contract for building and civil engineering construction, widely used on civil projects.

examples.en: It's a standard NZS 3910 contract with a few special conditions.
examples.zh: 这是标准 NZS 3910 合同，加了一些特殊条款。

words.note: 读作 “thirty-nine ten”。合同里的角色有 Principal（业主）、Contractor（承包商）、Engineer（工程师）。

words.zh: 合同工程师（代表业主管理合同）
words.definition: In NZS 3910 contracts, the person who administers the contract, values payments and decides on variations, and must act fairly.

examples.en: The Engineer to Contract hasn't approved our variation yet.
examples.zh: 合同工程师还没批准我们的变更。

words.note: 常简称 the Engineer 或 ETC。不是公司里的工程师，而是合同里的特定角色。

words.definition: In NZ construction contracts, the client who pays for the work.

examples.en: The principal is the regional council.
examples.zh: 业主是大区议会。

words.note: 不是“校长”或“本金”。日常也说 client。

words.definition: The main contractor who holds the contract with the client and manages the subcontractors.

examples.en: On this one we're a subcontractor to the head contractor.
examples.zh: 这个项目我们是总包下面的分包。

words.note: 也说 main contractor。

words.definition: A contract under which part of the main contract's work is done by another company.

examples.en: We'll subcontract the line marking.
examples.zh: 划线工作我们会分包出去。

words.definition: A company or person hired by the main contractor to do part of the work.

examples.en: Subcontractor invoices need to match the subcontract schedule.
examples.zh: 分包商的发票要和分包价格表对得上。

words.note: 口语叫 subbie（SUB-ee）。

words.definition: A business that sells materials, parts or services to the company.

examples.en: Every supplier needs to be set up in the system before we can raise a PO.
examples.zh: 每个供应商都要先在系统里建档，才能开采购单。

words.definition: A document the company sends a supplier to order goods or services at an agreed price; usually called a PO.

examples.en: No PO, no payment.
examples.zh: 没有采购单就不付款。

words.note: 口语说 PO（pee-OH）。三方匹配（three-way match）= PO + 收货/运单 + 发票。

words.definition: A bill from a supplier or to a client showing what is owed.

examples.en: The quarry invoice doesn't match the dockets.
examples.zh: 采石场的发票和运单对不上。

words.definition: A document from a supplier that cancels or reduces an invoice, for example for returned goods or a pricing error.

examples.en: Ask the hire company for a credit note for the days it was broken down.
examples.zh: 让租赁公司为设备坏掉的那几天开一张贷项通知单。

words.definition: When the client formally chooses a tenderer and gives them the contract.

examples.en: Contract award is expected in mid-June.
examples.zh: 预计六月中旬授标。

words.definition: The work that is included in a contract or project.

examples.en: Traffic management isn't in our scope.
examples.zh: 交通管理不在我们的工作范围内。

words.note: out of scope = 不在范围内；scope creep = 范围蔓延（不断加活儿）。

words.zh: 除外项（报价不包括的内容）
words.definition: Items listed in a tender or quote as not included in the price.

examples.en: Contaminated soil is one of our exclusions.
examples.zh: 污染土处理是我们报价的除外项之一。

words.definition: Conditions or assumptions a tenderer attaches to its price.

examples.en: The client didn't like the qualifications in our tender.
examples.zh: 业主不喜欢我们标书里的限定条件。

words.note: 另一个意思是“资历证书”，注意上下文。

words.zh: 计日工（按实际人工机械计费）
words.definition: Work paid on the actual time, plant and materials used, at agreed rates, rather than by measured quantities.

examples.en: Record it as dayworks and get the engineer to sign the sheet.
examples.zh: 按计日工记录，并让工程师在单子上签字。

words.note: 与 time and materials（T&M）意思接近。

words.definition: A pricing method where the client pays for the actual hours, plant and materials used, plus a margin.

examples.en: The emergency repairs were done on time and materials.
examples.zh: 抢修是按时间和材料计费的。

words.note: 缩写 T&M。

words.definition: The agreed final total value of a contract, including all variations and adjustments.

examples.en: We still haven't settled the final account from two years ago.
examples.zh: 两年前那个项目的竣工结算我们还没谈完。

words.definition: A guarantee, usually from a bank or insurer, that the contractor will meet its obligations under the contract.

examples.en: The contract requires a performance bond of ten percent.
examples.zh: 合同要求百分之十的履约保函。

words.definition: Insurance covering damage to the works being built during the contract.

examples.en: Check the excess on the contract works insurance.
examples.zh: 查一下工程险的免赔额。

words.definition: A contract to maintain roads, pipes or other assets over several years, paid through rates and lump sums.

examples.en: The roading maintenance contract gives us steady work for five years.
examples.zh: 道路养护合同给我们带来五年的稳定工作。

words.zh: 联盟合同（业主与承包商共担风险）
words.definition: A collaborative contract where the client, contractors and designers work as one team and share the risks and rewards.

examples.en: Alliance jobs have open-book accounting, so our costs have to be clean.
examples.zh: 联盟项目财务是开放账本，所以我们的成本要清清楚楚。

words.note: open-book（开卷/公开账目）在联盟和成本补偿型合同里常见。

words.definition: Early contractor involvement: bringing a contractor in during design to help with buildability, pricing and programme.

examples.en: We're in the ECI phase, so the design's still changing.
examples.zh: 我们还在早期介入阶段，所以设计还在变。

words.definition: A contract where the client pays the actual costs plus an agreed fee or margin.

examples.en: Under a cost reimbursable contract, every cost needs evidence.
examples.zh: 成本补偿合同下，每一笔成本都需要凭证。

words.note: 也说 cost-plus。

words.definition: In NZ and UK project talk, the project schedule showing what work happens when.

examples.en: We're two weeks behind programme on the bridge.
examples.zh: 桥梁工程比进度计划落后两周。

examples.en: Is that on the programme?
examples.zh: 这个在进度计划里吗？

words.note: 新西兰项目里的 programme 通常就是“进度计划/工期表”，不是电视节目或计算机程序（程序是 program）。

words.definition: A plan of when things happen; in contracts it can also mean a list or table, such as a schedule of prices.

examples.en: The schedule of prices and the programme are two different documents.
examples.zh: 价格表和进度计划是两份不同的文件。

words.note: 新西兰多读 SHED-yool，美式读 SKED-jool。合同里的 schedule 常指“附表/清单”，进度计划多说 programme。

words.zh: 近期滚动计划（如三周计划）
words.definition: A short-term detailed plan, often for the next two to four weeks, used to organise crews and plant.

examples.en: Put the crane on the three-week lookahead.
examples.zh: 把吊车写进三周滚动计划里。

words.note: plant 调度常基于 lookahead 来安排下周哪台机器去哪个项目。

words.definition: A bar chart showing tasks along a timeline, used to display a project programme.

examples.en: Can the app show the plant bookings as a Gantt chart?
examples.zh: 应用能把机械预订显示成甘特图吗？

words.definition: The chain of tasks that sets the shortest possible project duration; any delay on it delays the whole job.

examples.en: The culvert is on the critical path, so we can't let it slip.
examples.zh: 涵洞在关键路径上，所以不能拖。

words.definition: How long a task can be delayed without delaying the project's completion date.

examples.en: The landscaping has plenty of total float.
examples.zh: 景观工程有很多浮动时间。

words.note: 单说 float 也常指浮动时间；“who owns the float” 是合同争议常见话题。

words.definition: A key date or event in a programme, such as a road opening or a section handed over.

examples.en: Getting traffic onto the new lanes is the next big milestone.
examples.zh: 让车辆切换到新车道是下一个重要里程碑。

words.definition: The original approved programme or budget that progress and costs are measured against.

examples.en: Compared with the baseline, we're three weeks late.
examples.zh: 跟基准计划比，我们晚了三周。

words.definition: The current best estimate of the final cost, quantity or completion date.

examples.en: Update the forecast every month, not just the actuals.
examples.zh: 每个月都要更新预测，而不只是实际发生数。

words.definition: The expected total cost of the job when finished: cost to date plus cost to complete.

examples.en: Forecast final cost is now over budget by two hundred grand.
examples.zh: 预测最终成本现在超预算二十万。

words.note: 常缩写 FFC；grand = 一千（口语）。

words.definition: The total cost spent on a job so far.

examples.en: Cost to date is about sixty percent of budget.
examples.zh: 累计成本大约是预算的百分之六十。

words.definition: The estimated extra cost needed to finish the remaining work.

examples.en: The PM's cost to complete looks optimistic.
examples.zh: 项目经理估的完工尚需成本看着太乐观了。

words.note: 常缩写 CTC。

words.zh: 已承诺成本（已下单未付款）
words.definition: Costs the company has agreed to through purchase orders or subcontracts but not yet been invoiced for.

examples.en: Committed costs come from open POs and subcontracts.
examples.zh: 已承诺成本来自未结的采购单和分包合同。

words.zh: 挣值（已完成工作的预算价值）
words.definition: The budgeted value of the work actually done, compared with cost and plan to measure performance.

examples.en: Earned value shows we're spending faster than we're producing.
examples.zh: 挣值显示我们花钱的速度比产出快。

words.note: earned value management（EVM）常用指标：CPI（成本绩效）、SPI（进度绩效）。

words.definition: A comparison of what was budgeted with what was actually spent or produced.

examples.en: The board wants a budget vs actual for every job over a million.
examples.zh: 董事会要求每个一百万以上的项目都出预算与实际对比。

words.definition: Spending more than budgeted, or taking longer than planned.

examples.en: The cost overrun on the pipeline is mostly hire-in plant.
examples.zh: 管道项目的超支主要是外租机械。

words.note: 动词短语 run over（budget/time）。

words.definition: A code used to group costs by type of work or resource, such as excavation, pipelaying or plant.

examples.en: Half the timesheets have the wrong cost code.
examples.zh: 一半的工时表成本编码填错了。

words.note: 成本编码结构是 IT 项目里非常重要的主数据，要和估价、预算、工时、发票一致。

words.definition: The unique number for each job or project that all costs and revenue are charged to.

examples.en: Every docket must have a job number on it.
examples.zh: 每张运单上都必须写项目编号。

words.note: 施工行业说 job 往往就是 project；也叫 project number 或 contract number。

words.definition: Work breakdown structure: the project split into smaller parts, used to organise the programme, budget and costs.

examples.en: The cost codes follow the WBS of the tender.
examples.zh: 成本编码沿用投标时的工作分解结构。

words.definition: Tracking all labour, plant, materials and subcontract costs against each job.

examples.en: Job costing is only as good as the timesheets and dockets coming in.
examples.zh: 项目成本核算的准确度取决于交上来的工时表和运单。

words.definition: A regular report showing budget, cost to date, forecast and margin for a job.

examples.en: The monthly cost report is due on the fifth working day.
examples.zh: 月度成本报告在第五个工作日前交。

words.definition: The money coming in and going out of a business or project over time.

examples.en: Slow payment claims are hurting our cash flow.
examples.zh: 付款申请回款慢正在影响我们的现金流。

words.zh: S曲线（累计成本/进度曲线）
words.definition: A graph of cumulative cost or progress over time, usually shaped like an S.

examples.en: Plot the actuals on the S-curve against the baseline.
examples.zh: 把实际数据画在S曲线上和基准对比。

words.definition: How much work is produced for the labour and plant used.

examples.en: Productivity drops a lot in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天工效下降很多。

words.definition: The amount of work done per hour, day or shift, such as metres of pipe per day.

examples.en: The estimate assumed a production rate of forty metres a day.
examples.zh: 估价假设每天四十米的生产率。

words.definition: A common way to measure progress on linear work like pipes, kerbs and trenches.

examples.en: We're only doing twenty metres per day in this rock.
examples.zh: 在这种岩石里我们每天只能做二十米。

words.definition: The unit for volumes of soil, rock and concrete, written m³ and often said as cubes.

examples.en: We moved about four thousand cubic metres last week.
examples.zh: 上周我们运了大约四千立方米。

words.note: 口语常说 cubes 或 metres cubed；还要区分 bank（原状）、loose（松方）和 compacted（压实）体积。

words.definition: The metric unit of weight, 1,000 kg, used for aggregate, asphalt and truck loads.

examples.en: The quarry charges by the tonne.
examples.zh: 采石场按吨收费。

words.note: NZ 写 tonne（公吨），读音与 ton 相同。

words.definition: The daily record a foreman or engineer keeps of work done, weather, crews, plant, deliveries and events on site.

examples.en: Check the daily diary to see if it rained that day.
examples.zh: 查一下施工日志看那天有没有下雨。

words.note: 也叫 site diary。在索赔和争议中是重要证据。越来越多公司改用应用填写。

words.definition: A slip recording a delivery, truck load, hire or work done, signed on site as proof.

examples.en: We're still chasing last month's dockets.
examples.zh: 我们还在追上个月的单据。

words.note: 新西兰/澳洲常说 docket；美式多说 ticket 或 receipt。

words.definition: The slip that comes with a delivery showing what was delivered, how much and where, signed on receipt.

examples.en: Take a photo of the delivery docket and upload it.
examples.zh: 把送货单拍照上传。

words.definition: A record of the hours each worker, and often each machine, spent on each job and cost code.

examples.en: Timesheets have to be in by Monday ten o'clock for payroll.
examples.zh: 工时表周一十点前要交上来，才能做工资。

words.definition: The total hours worked by people on a job or task.

examples.en: Labour hours are twenty percent over on the kerbing.
examples.zh: 路缘石工程的人工工时超了百分之二十。

words.definition: Hours worked beyond normal hours, usually paid at a higher rate.

examples.en: The night works are blowing the overtime budget.
examples.zh: 夜间施工让加班预算爆了。

words.note: time and a half（1.5倍工资）、double time（双倍）是常见说法。

words.definition: Extra payments on top of wages, for example for meals, travel, dirty work or using your own tools.

examples.en: The payroll system needs to handle the meal and travel allowances.
examples.zh: 工资系统需要处理餐费和差旅津贴。

words.definition: A day when rain stops work on site; tracked because it can affect the programme and contract time.

examples.en: We've had six wet days this month.
examples.zh: 这个月有六个雨天停工日。

words.note: 与 extension of time 索赔相关。“rained out” = 被雨赶停。

words.definition: How much of a task or job is finished, as a percentage.

examples.en: The PM says it's seventy percent complete, but the costs say otherwise.
examples.zh: 项目经理说完成了百分之七十，但成本数据不这么说。

words.definition: When work takes longer than planned or is held up.

examples.en: Most of the delay was caused by late design changes.
examples.zh: 大部分延误是设计变更太晚造成的。

words.definition: A regular report to the client or management on what has been done, what's next, and any issues.

examples.en: The monthly progress report goes to the client with the claim.
examples.zh: 月度进度报告和付款申请一起交给业主。

words.definition: Request for information: a formal question to the designer or client to clarify drawings or specifications.

examples.en: We've sent an RFI about the clash between the drain and the water main.
examples.zh: 我们就排水管和供水主管冲突的问题发了 RFI。

words.note: RFI 记录需要编号、跟踪和答复时间，是项目管理系统的常见模块。

words.zh: 报审资料（提交审批的文件或样品）
words.definition: A document, sample or product data sent to the engineer for approval before use.

examples.en: The concrete mix design submittal is still with the engineer.
examples.zh: 混凝土配合比报审资料还在工程师那里。

words.definition: The plans and technical drawings showing what is to be built.

examples.en: Are we working off the latest drawings?
examples.zh: 我们用的是最新版图纸吗？

words.note: IFC drawings = issued for construction（施工版图纸）。

words.definition: The list of all project drawings with their current revision and status.

examples.en: The drawing register should be the single source of truth.
examples.zh: 图纸登记表应该是唯一可信来源。

words.definition: A record that documents or drawings were formally sent to someone, listing what was sent and when.

examples.en: Send it with a transmittal so we've got a record.
examples.zh: 附一张传送单发过去，这样有记录。

words.definition: Managing project documents so the right people have the current versions and old ones are withdrawn.

examples.en: Document control is a mess, people are emailing drawings around.
examples.zh: 文档控制一团糟，大家在用邮件互传图纸。

words.note: 负责这项工作的人叫 document controller。

words.definition: Operation and maintenance manual: the documents given to the owner explaining how to run and maintain what was built.

examples.en: The O&M manuals for the pump station are still outstanding.
examples.zh: 泵站的运维手册还没交。

words.definition: The full set of documents given to the client at the end of a job, including QA records, as-builts and manuals.

examples.en: We can't get our retentions back until the handover pack is done.
examples.zh: 移交资料没做完，我们就拿不回保留金。

words.note: 也说 completion documentation。
