words.definition: A formal check that processes and records are being followed correctly.

examples.en: There's a quality audit on the job next week.
examples.zh: 下周项目上有一次质量审核。

words.zh: ISO 9001 质量管理体系认证
words.definition: The international standard for quality management systems, often required to tender for public work.

examples.en: We need to keep our ISO 9001 certification for the council work.
examples.zh: 为了做市政的活，我们需要保持 ISO 9001 认证。

words.definition: The local government body in New Zealand, responsible for local roads, water, consents and rates.

examples.en: The council is the client on most of our roading jobs.
examples.zh: 我们大部分道路项目的业主是市政。

words.note: 新西兰有 city/district council（市/区议会）和 regional council（大区议会，管环境类许可）。

words.definition: Formal permission from a council to do something, such as earthworks or building.

examples.en: We can't start the earthworks until the consent comes through.
examples.zh: 许可下来之前我们不能开始土方。

words.note: 新西兰说 consent，很少说 permit（某些交通/道路许可除外）。

words.zh: 资源许可（环境与土地使用许可）
words.definition: Council permission for activities that affect the environment or land use, such as earthworks, discharges or taking water.

examples.en: The resource consent limits our working hours to 7 till 6.
examples.zh: 资源许可把我们的施工时间限制在七点到六点。

words.definition: The rules attached to a consent that the work must follow, such as noise limits, hours or monitoring.

examples.en: Breaching the consent conditions could get the job shut down.
examples.zh: 违反许可条件可能导致工程被叫停。

words.definition: Council permission to carry out building work, checked against the Building Code.

examples.en: The pump station building needs a building consent.
examples.zh: 泵站房需要建筑许可。

words.definition: Code compliance certificate: the council's confirmation that consented building work was done in line with the building consent.

examples.en: We can't hand over the building until the CCC is issued.
examples.zh: 合规证书发下来之前我们不能移交这栋建筑。

words.definition: A NZ statement from a qualified professional or contractor that design or construction meets requirements, numbered PS1 to PS4.

examples.en: The engineer will issue a PS4 once they've inspected the work.
examples.zh: 工程师检查完工作后会出具 PS4。

words.note: PS1 设计，PS2 设计复核，PS3 施工，PS4 施工复核。

words.definition: The company's set of procedures, forms and records for managing quality.

examples.en: The new app will replace the paper forms in our quality management system.
examples.zh: 新应用将取代我们质量管理体系中的纸质表格。

words.note: 缩写 QMS。

words.definition: The manager responsible for running the company's day-to-day work across jobs, crews and plant.

examples.en: The operations manager wants one report showing every crew and machine.
examples.zh: 运营经理想要一份能看到所有班组和机械的报告。

words.zh: 合同经理（管理多个项目）
words.definition: A senior manager who oversees several contracts or projects and their project managers.

examples.en: The contracts manager signs off variations over fifty grand.
examples.zh: 五万以上的变更由合同经理签批。

words.note: 不同公司职责差别很大：有的偏商务，有的偏项目运营。

words.definition: The person responsible for delivering a project on time, on budget and to the required quality.

examples.en: The project manager needs the cost report by Thursday.
examples.zh: 项目经理周四之前要成本报告。

words.note: 常缩写 PM。

words.definition: The person who manages a project's costs, payment claims, variations and subcontractor payments; usually called the QS.

examples.en: The QS needs the quantities for the month-end claim.
examples.zh: 工料测量师月底申请付款需要工程量。

words.note: 口语都说 QS（kyoo-ESS）。不是测量地形的 surveyor（测量员），而是管钱和合同的。

words.definition: The manager responsible for contracts, pricing, claims, cost reporting and commercial risk across projects.

examples.en: The commercial manager wants margin by job on one page.
examples.zh: 商务经理想在一页纸上看到每个项目的利润率。

words.definition: An engineer who supports the project manager with planning, quality, RFIs, quantities and reporting.

examples.en: The project engineer looks after the ITPs and RFIs.
examples.zh: 项目工程师负责检验计划和信息请求。

words.note: 新西兰施工公司里的 project engineer 常常是做管理协调的，不一定做设计。

words.definition: The manager responsible for the company's machines: buying, maintaining, allocating and disposing of them.

examples.en: The plant manager wants to know which machines are under-utilised.
examples.zh: 设备经理想知道哪些机器利用率不足。

words.note: 与 fleet manager 职责相近；有的公司 plant 管机械、fleet 管车辆。

words.definition: The manager responsible for the company's vehicles and often its plant, including compliance, costs and replacement.

examples.en: The fleet manager gets an alert when a CoF is about to expire.
examples.zh: CoF 快到期时车队经理会收到提醒。

words.definition: The person who books and allocates machines to jobs and arranges transport between sites.

examples.en: Ring the plant coordinator if you need a digger next week.
examples.zh: 下周需要挖掘机就给设备调度员打电话。

words.note: 职位名称各公司不同，也可能叫 plant allocator、plant scheduler 等。

words.definition: The person who runs the maintenance workshop, its mechanics and its job cards.

examples.en: The workshop manager wants the defects from the app to create job cards automatically.
examples.zh: 车间经理希望应用里报的故障能自动生成工单。

words.definition: Calculating and paying wages, or the team that does it.

examples.en: Payroll needs the timesheets approved by Monday.
examples.zh: 工资部门要求周一前审批完工时表。

words.definition: The team or process that checks and pays supplier and subcontractor invoices.

examples.en: Accounts payable can't pay the invoice without a matching PO.
examples.zh: 没有匹配的采购单，应付账款部门不能付这张发票。

words.note: 缩写 AP；对应的 accounts receivable（AR）是应收账款。

words.definition: Money owed to the company by clients, and the team that chases it.

examples.en: Accounts receivable is chasing the council for last month's claim.
examples.zh: 应收账款部门在追市政上个月的付款。

words.definition: Buying goods and services for the company, including choosing suppliers and negotiating prices.

examples.en: Procurement wants all hire-in to go through approved suppliers.
examples.zh: 采购部门希望所有外租都走认可的供应商。

words.definition: Human resources: the team that handles hiring, contracts, training records and staff issues.

examples.en: HR keeps the training and ticket records for operators.
examples.zh: 人力资源部门保存操作员的培训和证书记录。

words.definition: Enterprise resource planning: the main business system that handles finance, purchasing, payroll, assets and job costs.

examples.en: The ERP is the system of record for job costs.
examples.zh: 企业资源计划系统是项目成本的权威数据系统。

words.note: 不点名具体厂商；会议里常直接说 “the ERP” 或 “the finance system”。

words.definition: Software that manages jobs from quote to completion: scheduling, crews, plant, timesheets, dockets and costs.

examples.en: We need the job management system to talk to the ERP.
examples.zh: 我们需要项目管理系统和企业资源计划系统打通。

words.definition: A mobile app used by crews on site for timesheets, pre-starts, dockets, diaries and forms.

examples.en: The field app has to work offline, there's no reception out there.
examples.zh: 现场应用必须能离线用，那里没有信号。

words.note: 离线同步（offline sync）是现场应用的常见需求，因为工地常常没有信号。

words.definition: An app where workers or foremen enter hours against jobs, cost codes and machines.

examples.en: The guys hate the timesheet app because it takes too many taps.
examples.zh: 工人们讨厌工时应用，因为要点太多下。

words.definition: A docket filled in and signed on a phone or tablet instead of paper.

examples.en: With digital dockets we don't have to chase paper at month-end.
examples.zh: 有了电子单据，月底就不用追纸质单了。

words.note: 也叫 e-docket。

words.definition: Connecting two systems so data flows between them automatically.

examples.en: The integration between telematics and the asset register is one-way for now.
examples.zh: 车载系统和资产台账之间的集成目前是单向的。

words.definition: A screen showing key numbers and charts at a glance.

examples.en: The fleet dashboard shows availability and utilisation by depot.
examples.zh: 车队仪表板按车场显示可用率和利用率。

words.definition: Typing information into a system by hand.

examples.en: We want to cut down the double data entry between the app and the ERP.
examples.zh: 我们想减少应用和企业资源计划系统之间的重复录入。

words.note: double entry（重复录入）是会议中最常被抱怨的问题之一。

words.definition: The core shared records that other data depends on, such as jobs, cost codes, employees, assets and suppliers.

examples.en: If the master data is wrong, every report is wrong.
examples.zh: 主数据错了，所有报表都会错。

words.zh: 权威数据系统（数据以它为准）
words.definition: The system that holds the official, trusted version of a type of data.

examples.en: Which one's the system of record for engine hours?
examples.zh: 哪个系统是发动机小时数的权威来源？

words.note: 与 single source of truth（唯一可信来源）意思接近。

words.definition: A unit in the accounts, such as a depot, division or the workshop, that costs are grouped under.

examples.en: The workshop is its own cost centre.
examples.zh: 维修车间是单独的成本中心。

words.note: NZ/UK 拼写 centre，美式 center。

words.definition: The main accounting record where all financial transactions are recorded by account.

examples.en: Job costs post to the general ledger at month-end.
examples.zh: 项目成本在月底过账到总账。

words.note: 缩写 GL；GL code = 总账科目代码。

words.definition: The steps a document like a timesheet, PO or invoice goes through to be approved.

examples.en: Timesheets go to the foreman, then the PM, in the approval workflow.
examples.zh: 审批流程里工时表先给工长，再给项目经理。

words.definition: Goods and services tax: New Zealand's 15% tax added to most goods and services.

examples.en: Are those rates plus GST?
examples.zh: 这些费率不含商品及服务税吧？

words.note: 报价常写 “+GST” 或 “excl. GST”（不含税）。

words.definition: Pay as you earn: the income tax an employer deducts from wages and pays to IRD.

examples.en: Payroll calculates PAYE and KiwiSaver every pay run.
examples.zh: 每次发薪工资系统都会计算预扣税和 KiwiSaver。

words.definition: New Zealand's voluntary workplace retirement savings scheme, with employee and employer contributions.

examples.en: Don't forget employer KiwiSaver contributions in the labour rate.
examples.zh: 人工费率里别忘了雇主的 KiwiSaver 供款。

words.definition: The payments to New Zealand's Accident Compensation Corporation that fund injury cover; construction work has higher levies.

examples.en: ACC levies are part of our labour on-costs.
examples.zh: 意外赔偿征费是我们人工附加成本的一部分。

words.note: ACC 负责新西兰的无过错意外伤害保障。on-costs = 工资之外的人工附加成本。

words.definition: The NZ law that sets annual leave, public holidays and holiday pay; known for being hard to calculate correctly in payroll.

examples.en: Variable hours and allowances make Holidays Act calculations tricky.
examples.zh: 工时不固定加上各种津贴，让《假期法》的计算很棘手。

words.definition: The cost per hour of a worker, including wages and on-costs, used in pricing and job costing.

examples.en: The labour rate has to include KiwiSaver, ACC and leave.
examples.zh: 人工费率要包括 KiwiSaver、意外赔偿征费和假期。

words.definition: The date a new system starts being used for real.

examples.en: We can't go live in December, half the crews are on leave.
examples.zh: 十二月不能上线，一半的班组在休假。

words.note: 新西兰十二月底到一月初是施工行业长假（Christmas shutdown），系统上线常避开。

words.definition: User acceptance testing: when the real users test a new system before go-live.

examples.en: We need a couple of foremen and a QS for UAT.
examples.zh: 用户验收测试需要几个工长和一个工料测量师参与。

words.definition: An old system still in use that a new one is meant to replace.

examples.en: The plant rates still live in the legacy system.
examples.zh: 机械费率还存在旧系统里。

words.definition: A file like Excel used to calculate and track data; often where unofficial processes live.

examples.en: The plant allocation is still done on a spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 机械分配还在用电子表格做。

words.zh: 变通办法（临时解决方法）
words.definition: An unofficial way of getting something done because the system doesn't support it properly.

examples.en: Every depot has its own workaround for recording hire-in plant.
examples.zh: 每个车场记录外租机械都有自己的变通办法。

words.term: the crews are out on site
words.zh: 班组都在工地上（不在办公室）
words.definition: Said when the field workers are at their sites, often meaning they're hard to reach or can't attend.

examples.en: We'll have to do the training at 6.30, the crews are out on site by seven.
examples.zh: 培训得在六点半做，七点班组就都去工地了。

words.definition: Said when a machine has broken down and can't work.

examples.en: The plant's down, so the pipe crew is standing around.
examples.zh: 机器坏了，所以管道班组都在干等着。

words.note: down = 不能用；up and running = 恢复运行。

words.zh: 追单据（催收送货单/运单）
words.definition: Following people up to get missing delivery or truck dockets so costs and claims can be completed.

examples.en: We spend the first week of every month chasing the dockets.
examples.zh: 每个月第一周我们都在追单据。

words.note: chase 在办公室英语里是“催、追”：chase an invoice, chase a payment。

words.definition: To finish a job in the systems: final costs in, no more charges allowed, accounts settled.

examples.en: That job's closed off, so you can't code anything to it now.
examples.zh: 那个项目已经关了，现在不能再往里记任何费用。

words.definition: Means the task is planned in the project schedule.

examples.en: Don't worry about the line marking, it's on the programme for next week.
examples.zh: 划线不用担心，已经排在下周的计划里了。

words.definition: The last days of the month when claims, accruals, cost reports and payroll are finalised.

examples.en: Don't schedule the system cutover near month-end.
examples.zh: 系统切换不要安排在月底附近。

words.note: month-end close = 月末结账。

words.definition: The payment claim prepared at the end of each month for the work done that month.

examples.en: The QS needs the quantities for the month-end claim.
examples.zh: 工料测量师月底申请付款需要工程量。

words.zh: 事后成本复核（实际成本对比投标单价）
words.definition: Comparing actual costs and production on a finished or ongoing job against the tender rates, to improve future estimates.

examples.en: Back-costing showed our trenching rates were too low.
examples.zh: 事后成本复核显示我们的挖沟单价太低了。

words.note: 系统需要按成本编码和工程量准确记录，back-costing 才有意义。

words.zh: 应计费用（已发生未开票的成本）
words.definition: Costs recorded at month-end for work or goods already received but not yet invoiced.

examples.en: Put in an accrual for the quarry, their invoice won't arrive till next month.
examples.zh: 给采石场做一笔预提，他们的发票下个月才到。

words.definition: Work in progress report: shows for each job the revenue earned, costs, claims and margin, including over- or under-claiming.

examples.en: The WIP report goes to the board every month.
examples.zh: 在建工程报告每个月都要提交董事会。

words.note: 读作 “wip”。under-claimed / over-claimed 是指已申请的付款少于/多于已完成工作的价值。

words.definition: To record a cost against the job so it shows in that job's costs.

examples.en: If the ute's only used on that contract, charge it to the job.
examples.zh: 如果皮卡只用在那个合同上，就把费用记到该项目。

words.definition: To assign a cost or hours to a particular cost code or job number.

examples.en: Code the extra hours to the variation, not the base contract.
examples.zh: 额外工时记到变更编码上，不要记到原合同。

words.definition: The job is losing money.

examples.en: The job's in the red, so every variation counts.
examples.zh: 这个项目在亏钱，所以每个变更都很重要。

words.note: in the black = 盈利。

words.definition: Profit on a job is shrinking because costs are higher than planned.

examples.en: Margin's being eaten by all the hire-in plant.
examples.zh: 大量外租机械把利润吃掉了。

words.definition: To work out the cost and price of a piece of work.

examples.en: Can you price it up and send it to the engineer?
examples.zh: 你能估个价发给工程师吗？

words.definition: A rough estimate, not an exact number.

examples.en: Just give me a ballpark figure for the extra rock.
examples.zh: 给我一个多出来岩石的大概数字就行。

words.note: 也说 rough order of cost 或 ROM（rough order of magnitude）。

words.zh: 数字算不过来（不划算或对不上）
words.definition: The figures don't make sense or don't support the decision.

examples.en: Buying a new crane? The numbers don't stack up at that utilisation.
examples.zh: 买新吊车？那个利用率下算不过来。

words.definition: Said of a machine or vehicle that is stopped and not working, often for a while.

examples.en: We've got three diggers parked up in the yard.
examples.zh: 我们有三台挖掘机停在堆场不用。

words.definition: A machine can't be repaired until spare parts arrive.

examples.en: The grader's still waiting on parts from overseas.
examples.zh: 平地机还在等国外的零件。

words.zh: 调配机械（在项目间调动）
words.definition: To move machines between jobs to cover needs and avoid hiring in.

examples.en: We can shuffle the plant around rather than hire another roller.
examples.zh: 我们可以在项目间调机器，而不是再租一台压路机。

words.definition: Informal way to talk about crews and site staff, as opposed to office staff.

examples.en: The guys in the field won't use it if it's slow.
examples.zh: 如果慢，现场的人是不会用的。

words.note: field vs office（现场 vs 办公室）是很多 IT 讨论的核心分歧。guys 在新西兰口语中也包括女性。

words.zh: 重复处理（同一东西处理两次）
words.definition: Handling the same material or data twice, which wastes time and money.

examples.en: Writing it on paper and then typing it in is just double handling.
examples.zh: 先写在纸上再录入系统，就是重复劳动。

words.note: 原指材料搬运两次，现在也用于数据。

words.definition: Done on paper forms rather than in a system.

examples.en: The pre-starts are still paper-based at most depots.
examples.zh: 大部分车场的班前检查还是纸质的。

words.zh: （文件、审批）在某人手上待处理
words.definition: A document or approval is waiting with that person.

examples.en: The variation's sitting with the engineer.
examples.zh: 那份变更还在工程师那里压着。

words.definition: To get something approved or processed, often faster than normal.

examples.en: Can you push the PO through today? The supplier won't deliver without it.
examples.zh: 你今天能把采购单推过去吗？没有它供应商不送货。

words.definition: To agree fixed prices with a supplier or client for a period.

examples.en: Let's lock in the hire rates for the whole season.
examples.zh: 我们把整个季节的租赁费率锁定下来吧。

words.definition: A common question about which job, department or party pays for something.

examples.en: If the client changes the design, who's carrying the cost?
examples.zh: 如果业主改设计，这个费用谁来承担？

words.definition: Said when requested work isn't in the original contract, so it should be priced and paid separately.

examples.en: They want us to resurface the car park too? That's a variation.
examples.zh: 他们还要我们重铺停车场？那是变更。

words.definition: Not part of the agreed work or project.

examples.en: Integrating the payroll system is out of scope for phase one.
examples.zh: 对接工资系统不在第一阶段范围内。

words.definition: The period over Christmas and New Year when most NZ construction sites close for the summer holiday.

examples.en: Let's get the new app live before the Christmas shutdown.
examples.zh: 我们在圣诞停工前让新应用上线吧。

words.note: 新西兰施工行业常在十二月下旬到一月上中旬停工，具体日期各公司不同。

words.zh: 让机器保持干活（提高利用率）
words.definition: A common goal in plant meetings: keep machines earning instead of sitting idle.

examples.en: Our job is to keep the machines working and the hire-in down.
examples.zh: 我们的任务是让机器一直干活，并减少外租。

words.term: the data's only as good as what goes in
words.zh: 数据质量取决于录入质量
words.definition: A reminder that reports are only accurate if people enter correct data.

examples.en: The dashboard's great, but the data's only as good as what goes in.
examples.zh: 仪表板很棒，但数据好坏取决于录入的东西。

words.note: IT 版的说法是 “garbage in, garbage out”。

words.definition: To finish or get final approval for something.

examples.en: We just need the QS to sign it off to get it over the line.
examples.zh: 就差工料测量师签字就能搞定了。

words.definition: To do the calculations to check whether something makes sense.

examples.en: Let me run the numbers on buying versus hiring.
examples.zh: 我来算算买和租哪个划算。

words.definition: A project document setting out how quality will be managed on that job: procedures, ITPs, tests and responsibilities.

examples.en: The client wants our quality plan before we start on site.
examples.zh: 业主要求我们进场前提交质量计划。

words.definition: The action taken to fix a problem, such as a non-conformance, and stop it happening again.

examples.en: Every NCR needs a corrective action and a date.
examples.zh: 每份不合格报告都需要纠正措施和完成日期。

words.definition: To complete and formally close an item such as an NCR, RFI, defect or job.

examples.en: We've got forty RFIs still to close out.
examples.zh: 我们还有四十个信息请求没关闭。

words.note: 名词写 close-out：project close-out（项目收尾）。

words.definition: Detailed drawings made by a fabricator or subcontractor, such as for steel or precast, sent for approval before making the items.

examples.en: The precast shop drawings are waiting for the engineer's approval.
examples.zh: 预制构件的深化图在等工程师批准。

words.definition: The formal certificate issued under the contract confirming the works have reached practical completion.

examples.en: Retentions start to be released once the certificate of practical completion is issued.
examples.zh: 实际完工证书签发后，保留金开始释放。

words.definition: A review at the end of a job or phase to record what went well and what to do differently.

examples.en: Put the docket problems in the lessons learned for the next job.
examples.zh: 把单据问题写进经验教训总结，供下个项目参考。

words.definition: A form filled in on a phone, tablet or computer instead of paper, such as a checklist or inspection record.

examples.en: We've turned the paper ITP checklists into digital forms.
examples.zh: 我们把纸质的检验检查表改成了电子表单。

words.note: 也说 e-form 或 smart form。

words.definition: Photos taken and stored as evidence of work done, conditions or damage, usually with date and location.

examples.en: Take a photo record of the road before we start, in case of damage claims.
examples.zh: 开工前给道路拍照留证，以防损坏索赔。
